exercises.name: Jumping jacks
steps: Stand tall, feet together, arms at your sides.
Jump your feet out wider than your hips while swinging your arms overhead.
Jump back to the start in one smooth rhythm.
exercises.cue: Stay light on the balls of your feet. For low impact, step one foot out at a time instead.

exercises.name: Inchworm
steps: Stand tall, then hinge forward and place your hands on the floor, bending your knees as much as you need.
Walk your hands out until you're in a high plank.
Hold for a breath, then walk your hands back to your feet and stand up.
exercises.cue: Keep your hips level in the plank.

exercises.name: World's greatest stretch
steps: Step your right foot forward into a long lunge and put your left hand on the floor.
Drop your right elbow toward the inside of your right foot.
Rotate and reach your right arm to the ceiling, eyes following your hand.
Step back and repeat on the other side. Keep alternating.
exercises.cue: Squeeze the back leg's glute to open the front of the hip.

exercises.name: Deep squat with reach
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width, toes slightly out.
Sink into your deepest comfortable squat, elbows gently pushing your knees out.
Reach one arm overhead and rotate, then the other.
Stand up and repeat.
exercises.cue: Keep your heels on the floor.

exercises.name: Leg swings
steps: Hold a wall or chair for balance.
Swing one leg forward and back 10 times, then side to side 10 times.
Switch legs halfway through.
exercises.cue: Controlled swings that grow bigger each rep.

exercises.name: Arm circles
steps: Stand with arms straight out to the sides.
Make small circles forward, gradually growing them into big circles.
Halfway through, reverse direction.
exercises.cue: Keep your ribs down; don't arch your back.

exercises.name: Cat-cow
steps: Start on hands and knees, hands under shoulders, knees under hips.
Breathe in as you drop your belly and lift your chest and tailbone.
Breathe out as you round your back toward the ceiling and tuck your chin.
Move slowly between the two.
exercises.cue: Move one vertebra at a time.

exercises.name: Glute bridge march
steps: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat, and lift your hips into a bridge.
Keeping your hips high and level, lift one knee toward your chest.
Put it down and lift the other. Keep alternating.
exercises.cue: Hips stay level as you march.

exercises.name: Child's pose
steps: Kneel with big toes touching and knees wide.
Sit your hips back toward your heels and walk your hands forward.
Rest your forehead down and breathe slowly into your back.
exercises.cue: Long, slow exhales.

exercises.name: Half-kneeling hip flexor stretch
steps: Kneel on your right knee with your left foot forward.
Tuck your tailbone under and squeeze your right glute.
Shift forward gently until you feel a stretch in the front of the right hip.
Switch sides halfway through.
exercises.cue: Small tuck, big stretch. Don't arch your back.

exercises.name: Figure-4 stretch
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent.
Cross your right ankle over your left knee.
Pull your left thigh toward your chest until you feel the stretch in your right hip.
Switch sides halfway through.
exercises.cue: Keep your head and shoulders relaxed on the floor.

exercises.name: Seated hamstring fold
steps: Sit with legs straight out in front of you.
Hinge forward from your hips, reaching toward your shins or feet.
Hold where you feel a stretch, breathing slowly.
exercises.cue: Lead with your chest, not your head.

exercises.name: Thread the needle
steps: Start on hands and knees.
Slide your right arm under your left arm, lowering your right shoulder and temple to the floor.
Hold, then switch sides halfway through.
exercises.cue: Let your upper back rotate; keep hips over knees.

exercises.name: Wall chest stretch
steps: Stand beside a wall or doorframe and place your forearm on it, elbow at shoulder height.
Gently turn your body away until you feel a stretch across your chest.
Switch sides halfway through.
exercises.cue: Easy pressure only.

exercises.name: Snap-downs
steps: Stand tall on your toes with arms reaching overhead.
Swing your arms down fast and drop into a quarter squat, landing flat-footed with feet shoulder-width.
Freeze the landing for 2 seconds: knees over toes, chest up.
Stand up and reset.
exercises.cue: Land quietly and stick it. This drill teaches the landing every other jump relies on.
exercises.avoid: Knees caving inward on the landing.

exercises.name: Pogo hops
steps: Stand with feet hip-width, knees almost straight, hands on hips.
Bounce straight up off the balls of your feet, using your ankles like springs.
Spend as little time on the ground as possible.
Keep a steady rhythm.
exercises.cue: Stiff ankles, springy feet, very little knee bend.
exercises.avoid: Heels slamming into the floor.

exercises.name: Squat jumps
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width, sink into a quarter-to-half squat and swing your arms back.
Swing your arms forward and jump straight up as high as you can.
Land softly on the balls of your feet, rolling to flat feet as you sink back into the squat.
Reset your stance, then go again.
exercises.cue: Every rep is a max effort. Take a breath between reps.
exercises.avoid: Landing stiff-legged or with knees collapsing inward.

exercises.name: Skater hops
steps: Stand on your right leg with a slight knee bend.
Push off sideways and hop to land on your left leg.
Let your right leg swing behind the left, touching down lightly if you need balance.
Push back the other way.
exercises.cue: Stick each landing for a beat. For low impact, step side to side instead of hopping.
exercises.avoid: Landing on a straight knee.

exercises.name: Broad jumps
steps: Stand with feet hip-width, swing your arms back as you hinge into a half squat.
Drive your arms forward and jump forward as far as you can.
Land softly on both feet in a squat, knees tracking over toes.
Stand, walk back, and reset.
exercises.cue: Stick the landing. If you tip forward, jump a little less far.
exercises.avoid: Rushing reps without resetting.

exercises.name: Split-squat jumps
steps: Start in a split stance, back knee just above the floor.
Jump up explosively and switch legs in the air.
Land softly in the opposite split stance and sink straight into the next rep.
exercises.cue: Tall torso. Land with your front foot flat.
exercises.avoid: Front knee collapsing inward.

exercises.name: Lateral bounds
steps: Stand on your right leg with your hips back.
Jump as far as you can to the left, landing on your left leg.
Stick the landing for 2 seconds.
Bound back to the right. That's one rep each side.
exercises.cue: The distance comes from your hips. Land soft.
exercises.avoid: Wobbly landings. Shorten the jump until you can stick it.

exercises.name: Tuck jumps
steps: Stand with feet hip-width, arms at your sides.
Jump straight up and pull your knees toward your chest.
Extend your legs to land softly on the balls of your feet.
Rebound into the next rep, or reset if your form slips.
exercises.cue: Bring your knees up, not your feet back.
exercises.avoid: Heavy, loud landings.

exercises.name: Single-leg hops
steps: Stand on one leg with a slight knee bend.
Hop forward a short distance and land on the same leg.
Hold the landing for 2 seconds, then hop again.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.
exercises.cue: Quality over distance.
exercises.avoid: Knee drifting inward on the landing.

exercises.name: Explosive incline push-ups
steps: Put your hands on a sturdy bench, couch arm or counter, body in a straight line.
Lower your chest to the edge.
Push hard enough that your hands briefly leave the surface.
Catch yourself with soft elbows and flow into the next rep.
exercises.cue: Fast up, controlled down.
exercises.avoid: Hips sagging as you push.

exercises.name: Plyo push-ups
steps: Start in a strong push-up position.
Lower your chest toward the floor under control.
Explode up so your hands leave the ground.
Land with soft elbows and go straight into the next rep.
exercises.cue: Stop the set as soon as reps slow down.
exercises.avoid: Landing with locked elbows.

exercises.name: Bodyweight squat
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width, toes turned slightly out.
Sit your hips down and back between your heels, reaching your arms forward.
Go as deep as you can with a neutral spine and heels down.
Drive through your whole foot to stand.
exercises.cue: Knees track in line with your toes.
exercises.avoid: Heels lifting off the floor.

exercises.name: Goblet squat
steps: Hold a dumbbell or kettlebell vertically at your chest, elbows tucked.
Stand with feet shoulder-width, toes slightly out.
Squat down until your elbows brush the inside of your knees.
Drive up, keeping the weight close to your chest.
exercises.cue: Chest proud; the weight shouldn't pull you forward.
exercises.avoid: Rounding your back at the bottom.

exercises.name: Tempo squat (3 seconds down)
steps: Set up like a regular squat, feet shoulder-width.
Take a slow 3-count on the way down.
Pause for 1 second at the bottom.
Stand up at normal speed.
exercises.cue: Control the whole descent.
exercises.avoid: Bouncing out of the bottom.

exercises.name: Dumbbell front squat
steps: Hold a dumbbell on each shoulder, elbows pointing forward.
Stand with feet shoulder-width.
Squat as deep as you can with an upright torso.
Drive up through your whole foot.
exercises.cue: Keep your elbows high.
exercises.avoid: Letting your torso fold forward.

exercises.name: Pistol squat to box
steps: Stand in front of a bench or chair on one leg, the other leg held straight out in front.
Reach your arms forward and slowly sit back to the box on one leg.
Touch down lightly without relaxing.
Drive up through the standing leg.
exercises.cue: Slow and controlled on the way down.
exercises.avoid: Plopping onto the box.

exercises.name: Glute bridge
steps: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat and hip-width, arms by your sides.
Press through your heels and lift your hips until knees, hips and shoulders line up.
Squeeze your glutes for a second at the top.
Lower with control.
exercises.cue: Ribs down. Drive with your glutes, not your lower back.
exercises.avoid: Over-arching your lower back at the top.

exercises.name: Single-leg glute bridge
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Lift one foot off the floor, knee bent.
Press through the planted heel to lift your hips level.
Lower with control. Finish all reps, then switch.
exercises.cue: Keep your hips level; don't let one side drop.
exercises.avoid: Pushing from your lower back.

exercises.name: Single-leg Romanian deadlift
steps: Stand on your right leg with a soft knee. Hold a dumbbell in your left hand if you have one.
Hinge forward at the hips, letting your left leg extend straight behind you.
Lower until your torso is nearly parallel to the floor or you feel a strong hamstring stretch.
Squeeze your right glute to return to standing.
exercises.cue: Hips square to the floor, like a seesaw.
exercises.avoid: Rounding your back to reach lower.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Romanian deadlift
steps: Stand holding dumbbells in front of your thighs, feet hip-width.
Soften your knees and push your hips back, sliding the weights down your legs.
Stop when you feel a strong hamstring stretch, usually around mid-shin.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
exercises.cue: Flat back. Weights stay close to your legs.
exercises.avoid: Rounding your back to reach lower.

exercises.name: Kettlebell or dumbbell swing
steps: Stand with feet a bit wider than hips, the weight on the floor a foot in front of you.
Hinge, grip it with both hands and hike it back between your legs.
Snap your hips forward to float the weight to chest height; your arms only guide it.
Let it fall back between your legs and hinge straight into the next rep.
exercises.cue: It's a hip snap, not a squat and not an arm raise.
exercises.avoid: Lifting with your arms or lower back.

exercises.name: Band good morning
steps: Stand on the band with feet hip-width and loop the other end behind your upper back.
Soften your knees and hinge forward with a flat back.
Stop when you feel a strong hamstring stretch.
Squeeze your glutes to stand tall.
exercises.cue: Push your hips back like closing a car door with your butt.
exercises.avoid: Rounding your back.

exercises.name: Reverse lunge
steps: Stand tall with feet hip-width.
Step one foot back and lower until both knees are about 90 degrees.
Keep most of your weight in the front heel.
Push through the front foot to return. Alternate legs.
exercises.cue: Torso tall; the back knee drops straight down.
exercises.avoid: Front knee caving inward.

exercises.name: Lateral lunge
steps: Stand with a wide stance, toes pointing forward.
Shift your hips back and to one side, bending that knee while the other leg stays straight.
Keep both feet flat on the floor.
Push back to center and alternate sides.
exercises.cue: Sit back into the hip, like a one-sided squat.
exercises.avoid: Letting the bent knee cave inward.

exercises.name: Dumbbell reverse lunge
steps: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Step one foot back and lower until both knees are about 90 degrees.
Drive through the front heel to return.
Alternate legs.
exercises.cue: Stay tall; let the weights hang straight down.
exercises.avoid: Leaning forward over the front knee.

exercises.name: Bulgarian split squat
steps: Stand about two feet in front of a bench or couch and rest your back foot, laces down, on it.
Lower straight down until your front thigh is near parallel to the floor.
Keep your front heel down and lean your torso slightly forward.
Drive through the front foot to stand. Finish all reps, then switch. Hold dumbbells if you have them.
exercises.cue: Most of the work is in the front leg.
exercises.avoid: Front heel lifting.

exercises.name: Cossack squat
steps: Stand with a very wide stance, toes slightly out.
Sit deep into one hip while the other leg straightens and its toes point up.
Keep the bent leg's heel down and your chest up.
Shift through the bottom to the other side.
exercises.cue: Go only as deep as you can with a flat heel.
exercises.avoid: Heel lifting on the bent leg.

exercises.name: Walking lunge
steps: Stand tall with space in front of you.
Step forward into a lunge, lowering until both knees are about 90 degrees.
Drive through the front foot and bring the back foot forward into the next lunge.
Keep walking, alternating legs.
exercises.cue: Tall chest, steady pace.
exercises.avoid: Short steps that push the knee far past the toes.

exercises.name: Incline push-up
steps: Place your hands on a bench, table or counter, slightly wider than shoulders.
Walk your feet back until your body forms a straight line.
Lower your chest to the edge, elbows about 45 degrees from your body.
Press back up.
exercises.cue: The lower the surface, the harder it gets.
exercises.avoid: Hips sagging.

exercises.name: Push-up
steps: Hands slightly wider than shoulders, body in a straight line from head to heels.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
Lower your chest to just above the floor, elbows about 45 degrees from your body.
Press the floor away to return.
exercises.cue: Your body moves as one solid plank.
exercises.avoid: Hips sagging or elbows flaring straight out.

exercises.name: Pike push-up
steps: Start in a push-up position, then walk your feet in and lift your hips into an upside-down V.
Bend your elbows to lower the top of your head toward the floor between your hands.
Press back up to the V.
exercises.cue: Hips stay high; this targets the shoulders.
exercises.avoid: Dropping into a regular push-up.

exercises.name: Decline push-up
steps: Put your feet on a bench or step and your hands on the floor.
Form a straight line from head to heels.
Lower your chest to just above the floor.
Press back up.
exercises.cue: Keep your core tight so your hips don't pike.
exercises.avoid: Hips sagging.

exercises.name: Dumbbell floor press
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and a dumbbell in each hand, upper arms on the floor at about 45 degrees.
Press the weights straight up over your chest.
Lower until your upper arms touch the floor and pause briefly.
Press again.
exercises.cue: Wrists stacked over elbows.
exercises.avoid: Bouncing your elbows off the floor.

exercises.name: Dumbbell overhead press
steps: Stand with feet hip-width, dumbbells at shoulder height, palms facing in.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
Press the weights overhead until your arms are straight, biceps by your ears.
Lower with control to your shoulders.
exercises.cue: Ribs down the whole time.
exercises.avoid: Leaning back to finish the press.

exercises.name: Band chest press
steps: Anchor the band behind you at chest height, in a door anchor or around a post.
Hold an end in each hand and step forward until there's tension.
Press both hands straight forward until your arms are extended.
Return slowly.
exercises.cue: Stagger your stance for balance.
exercises.avoid: Letting the band snap your arms back.

exercises.name: Prone Y-T raises
steps: Lie face down with your forehead on a folded towel and arms overhead in a Y, thumbs up.
Lift your arms off the floor by squeezing your shoulder blades back and down. Hold 2 seconds, lower.
Move your arms out to a T and repeat.
Y plus T is one rep.
exercises.cue: Small lifts are fine. Feel it between your shoulder blades.
exercises.avoid: Shrugging your shoulders toward your ears.

exercises.name: Superman lat pulls
steps: Lie face down with your arms straight overhead.
Lift your chest and arms slightly off the floor.
Pull your elbows down toward your ribs as if doing a pull-up, squeeze, then reach back out.
Stay lifted for the whole set.
exercises.cue: Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the bottom of each pull.
exercises.avoid: Cranking your neck up.

exercises.name: Band row
steps: Anchor the band in front of you at chest height, or loop it around your feet while seated with legs straight.
Hold an end in each hand with arms straight.
Row your hands to your lower ribs, elbows close to your body.
Squeeze your shoulder blades, then return slowly.
exercises.cue: Lead with your elbows.
exercises.avoid: Shrugging or leaning way back.

exercises.name: Bent-over dumbbell row
steps: Hold dumbbells and hinge forward to about 45 degrees with a flat back, arms hanging.
Row the weights toward your lower ribs, elbows close to your body.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
Lower with control.
exercises.cue: Keep your torso still; only your arms move.
exercises.avoid: Rounding your back or jerking the weight up.

exercises.name: Single-arm dumbbell row
steps: Place one hand and knee on a bench or chair, other foot on the floor, back flat.
Hold a dumbbell in your free hand, arm hanging straight.
Row it toward your hip, elbow close to your body.
Lower with control. Finish all reps, then switch.
exercises.cue: Pull toward your back pocket.
exercises.avoid: Twisting your torso to lift the weight.

exercises.name: Band pull-apart
steps: Hold the band at shoulder height with straight arms, hands shoulder-width apart.
Pull the band apart by moving your hands out to the sides until it touches your chest.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly.
exercises.cue: Arms stay straight; shoulders stay down.
exercises.avoid: Arching your back.

exercises.name: Scapular pull-ups
steps: Hang from the bar with straight arms.
Without bending your elbows, pull your shoulder blades down and together so your body rises slightly.
Hold for a second, then lower back to a full hang.
exercises.cue: A small movement, all from the shoulder blades.
exercises.avoid: Bending your elbows.

exercises.name: Pull-up negatives
steps: Use a step or a small jump to get your chin over the bar.
Lower yourself as slowly as you can, aiming for 3 to 5 seconds.
At the bottom, step down and reset.
exercises.cue: Fight gravity the whole way down.
exercises.avoid: Dropping through the bottom half.

exercises.name: Pull-up
steps: Hang from the bar with hands slightly wider than shoulders, palms facing away.
Pull your shoulder blades down, then drive your elbows toward your ribs.
Pull until your chin clears the bar.
Lower all the way to straight arms.
exercises.cue: Full range: straight arms at the bottom, chin over at the top.
exercises.avoid: Kicking or swinging to get up.

exercises.name: Dead bug
steps: Lie on your back with arms straight up and hips and knees bent to 90 degrees.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Slowly extend the opposite arm and leg toward the floor without letting your back lift.
Return and switch sides.
exercises.cue: Slow is the point. Breathe out as you extend.
exercises.avoid: Lower back peeling off the floor.

exercises.name: Bird dog
steps: Start on hands and knees, hands under shoulders, knees under hips.
Reach one arm forward and the opposite leg back until both are level with your body.
Hold for 2 seconds without shifting your hips.
Return and switch sides.
exercises.cue: Imagine balancing a glass of water on your lower back.
exercises.avoid: Twisting your hips as the leg lifts.

exercises.name: Side plank
steps: Lie on your side with your elbow under your shoulder and legs stacked. Bend your knees for an easier version.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line.
Hold, breathing steadily.
Switch sides.
exercises.cue: Push the floor away with your forearm.
exercises.avoid: Hips sagging toward the floor.

exercises.name: Plank shoulder taps
steps: Start in a high plank with feet a bit wider than hips.
Lift one hand and tap the opposite shoulder.
Put it down and tap with the other hand.
Keep your hips as still as possible.
exercises.cue: Wider feet make it easier; narrower feet make it harder.
exercises.avoid: Hips rocking side to side.

exercises.name: Bear crawl
steps: Start on hands and knees, then lift your knees an inch off the floor.
Move your opposite hand and foot forward a few inches at the same time.
Crawl forward a few steps, then backward.
Keep your knees low throughout.
exercises.cue: Back flat enough to balance a cup on.
exercises.avoid: Hips shooting up high.

exercises.name: Hollow hold
steps: Lie on your back and press your lower back into the floor.
Lift your shoulders, arms and legs off the floor, arms by your ears.
Hold a shallow banana shape.
Bend your knees if your back starts to lift.
exercises.cue: Lower back stays glued down.
exercises.avoid: Arching off the floor.

exercises.name: Suitcase carry
steps: Hold one heavy dumbbell or kettlebell at your side.
Stand tall with shoulders level.
Walk slowly and steadily, not leaning toward either side.
Switch hands halfway.
exercises.cue: Walk as if you weren't carrying anything.
exercises.avoid: Leaning away from the weight.

exercises.name: Farmer carry
steps: Hold a heavy weight in each hand at your sides.
Stand tall, shoulders back and down.
Walk with short, controlled steps.
Turn around carefully when you run out of space.
exercises.cue: Grip hard, ribs down.
exercises.avoid: Shrugging your shoulders up.

exercises.name: Pallof press
steps: Anchor the band at chest height and stand side-on to it, holding the end at your chest with both hands.
Step away until there's tension.
Press your hands straight out in front of you and resist the band pulling you toward the anchor.
Bring your hands back to your chest. Finish all reps, then face the other way.
exercises.cue: Don't let your torso rotate.
exercises.avoid: Turning toward the anchor.

exercises.name: Box jumps
steps: Stand about a foot from a box you can land on in a quarter squat.
Swing your arms back and dip into a half squat.
Jump and land softly on the box with your whole foot, in the same quarter squat.
Stand tall, then step down. Don't jump down.
exercises.cue: Pick a height you land on easily. Height isn't the goal; a quiet landing is.
exercises.avoid: Landing in a deep squat, which means the box is too high.

exercises.name: Depth jumps
steps: Stand on a low box, knee height or lower.
Step off the edge. Don't jump off.
As soon as both feet touch the floor, jump straight up as high as you can.
Land softly, walk back and reset.
exercises.cue: Spend as little time on the ground as possible.
exercises.avoid: Sinking into a deep squat before the jump.

exercises.name: Tire jump-ins
steps: Stand facing a tire lying flat on the floor.
Jump over the sidewall and land softly in the center.
Jump out over the far side.
Turn around and repeat. In plus out is one rep.
exercises.cue: Clear the rim with room to spare.
exercises.avoid: Clipping the rim with your toes.

exercises.name: Wall-ball shots
steps: Hold a medicine ball at your chest, standing about an arm's length from a wall.
Squat down with your chest up.
Drive up explosively and throw the ball to a target about 10 feet (3 m) up the wall.
Catch it and absorb it straight into the next squat.
exercises.cue: Your legs throw the ball; your arms just finish it.
exercises.avoid: Catching with locked arms.

exercises.name: Ball slams
steps: Hold the ball overhead with straight arms, up on your toes.
Slam it into the floor in front of you as hard as you can, hinging your hips back.
Squat down to pick it up with a flat back.
Reset overhead and repeat.
exercises.cue: Use a non-bouncy slam ball so it doesn't rebound into your face.
exercises.avoid: Rounding your back to pick up the ball.

exercises.name: Medicine ball chest pass
steps: Stand facing a solid wall about 3 feet (1 m) away, ball at your chest.
Step forward and throw the ball into the wall as hard as you can, like a basketball chest pass.
Catch the rebound with soft elbows.
Reset your feet and repeat.
exercises.cue: Fast, violent throws. Every rep is a max effort.
exercises.avoid: Letting the ball slam back into your chest.

exercises.name: Rotational wall throw
steps: Stand side-on to a wall about 3 feet (1 m) away, ball held at the hip farthest from the wall.
Turn your hips and shoulders together and throw the ball into the wall.
Catch it and reset.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.
exercises.cue: The power starts from your back hip, not your arms.
exercises.avoid: Twisting only through your lower back.

exercises.name: Barbell back squat
steps: Set the bar in the rack at mid-chest height and the safety pins just below your lowest squat.
Step under, rest the bar on your upper back (not your neck), grip just outside your shoulders, stand and take two steps back.
Brace your core and squat to at least thigh-parallel.
Drive up through your whole foot. Rack the bar when the set is done.
exercises.cue: Choose a weight you could lift 2 or 3 more times.
exercises.avoid: Your chest dropping or knees caving on the way up.

exercises.name: Barbell front squat
steps: Set the bar at mid-chest height and rest it across the front of your shoulders, elbows high.
Step back, feet shoulder-width.
Squat as deep as you can with an upright torso.
Drive up, leading with your elbows.
exercises.cue: Elbows high keeps the bar on your shoulders.
exercises.avoid: Elbows dropping and the bar rolling forward.

exercises.name: Box squat
steps: Stand in front of a box or bench, feet shoulder-width. Hold a weight at your chest if you want more challenge.
Sit your hips back until you lightly touch the box.
Stay tight; don't relax onto it.
Drive up to standing.
exercises.cue: Touch and go. The box just teaches depth.
exercises.avoid: Plopping down onto the box.

exercises.name: Barbell Romanian deadlift
steps: Hold the bar in front of your thighs with a shoulder-width grip.
Soften your knees and push your hips back, sliding the bar down your legs.
Stop at a strong hamstring stretch, usually around mid-shin.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
exercises.cue: The bar stays in contact with your legs.
exercises.avoid: Rounding your back to go lower.

exercises.name: Barbell deadlift
steps: Stand with the bar over the middle of your feet, feet hip-width.
Hinge down and grip just outside your legs, shins touching the bar.
Chest up, back flat; pull the slack out of the bar.
Push the floor away to stand tall, then lower by pushing your hips back first.
exercises.cue: Think leg press, not back pull.
exercises.avoid: Rounding your back or jerking the bar off the floor.

exercises.name: Barbell hip thrust
steps: Sit on the floor with your upper back against the long side of a bench and a padded barbell over your hips.
Plant your feet flat, about hip-width.
Drive your hips up until your torso is level, chin tucked.
Squeeze your glutes at the top, then lower with control.
exercises.cue: Shins vertical at the top.
exercises.avoid: Arching your lower back to finish.

exercises.name: Stability ball hamstring curl
steps: Lie on your back with your heels on a stability ball, arms out to the sides.
Lift your hips into a bridge.
Bend your knees to roll the ball toward you.
Roll it back out while keeping your hips up.
exercises.cue: Hips stay high the whole set.
exercises.avoid: Hips dropping as you roll out.

exercises.name: Tire flips
steps: Squat down with your fingers under the tire's bottom edge and your chest against it.
Drive through your legs and hips to lift it, like a deadlift.
When it passes your knees, drive your hips forward and switch to pushing with your hands.
Push it over, walk up and repeat.
exercises.cue: It's a deadlift into a push. Keep your chest against the tire.
exercises.avoid: Curling it up with your arms or rounding your back.

exercises.name: Box step-up
steps: Stand facing a box or bench at knee height or lower. Hold dumbbells for more challenge.
Put your whole right foot on the box.
Drive through that heel to stand on top, without pushing off the back foot.
Step down with control. Finish all reps, then switch.
exercises.cue: The top leg does all the work.
exercises.avoid: Bouncing off the back foot.

exercises.name: BOSU split squat
steps: Put your front foot in the center of the BOSU dome and your back foot on the floor behind you.
Lower straight down until your back knee nearly touches the floor.
Keep your front knee steady over your foot.
Drive up. Finish all reps, then switch.
exercises.cue: Slow and steady; the wobble trains your knee and ankle control.
exercises.avoid: Front knee wobbling inward.

exercises.name: Barbell bench press
steps: Lie on the bench with eyes under the bar, feet flat and shoulder blades squeezed together.
Grip slightly wider than shoulders and unrack the bar over your chest.
Lower it to your mid-chest, elbows about 45 degrees from your body.
Press back up. Use a spotter or safety arms for heavier sets.
exercises.cue: Keep your shoulder blades pinned to the bench.
exercises.avoid: Bouncing the bar off your chest.

exercises.name: Dumbbell bench press
steps: Lie on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand at your chest, feet flat.
Press the weights up until your arms are straight over your chest.
Lower slowly until the dumbbells reach chest level.
Press again.
exercises.cue: Wrists stacked over elbows.
exercises.avoid: Flaring your elbows straight out to the sides.

exercises.name: Incline dumbbell press
steps: Set the bench to a low incline, about 30 degrees.
Start with dumbbells at your upper chest.
Press up and slightly back until your arms are straight.
Lower under control.
exercises.cue: Low incline hits chest and shoulders together.
exercises.avoid: Arching off the bench.

exercises.name: Barbell overhead press
steps: Hold the bar at your collarbones, grip just outside your shoulders.
Squeeze your glutes and brace your core.
Press the bar straight up, moving your head back slightly so it passes your face.
Push your head through once the bar is overhead, then lower to your collarbones.
exercises.cue: Bar path is a straight line.
exercises.avoid: Leaning back to finish the press.

exercises.name: Ring or TRX push-up
steps: Set the handles at knee height, grab them and walk your feet back into a leaning plank.
Lower your chest between your hands, keeping the handles close to your body.
Press back up to straight arms.
Step your feet back to make it harder, forward to make it easier.
exercises.cue: Hold the handles still; don't let them drift apart.
exercises.avoid: Hips sagging.

exercises.name: Ring dips
steps: Jump or step up to support yourself on the rings with straight arms, rings turned out slightly.
Lower until your shoulders are just below your elbows.
Press back up to straight arms.
exercises.cue: Rings stay close to your body.
exercises.avoid: Shoulders rolling forward at the bottom.

exercises.name: Bench dips
steps: Sit on the edge of a bench, hands beside your hips, fingers forward.
Slide your hips off the bench with knees bent.
Bend your elbows to lower until your upper arms are about parallel to the floor.
Press back up.
exercises.cue: Keep your hips close to the bench.
exercises.avoid: Shrugging your shoulders toward your ears.

exercises.name: Ring or TRX row
steps: Hold the handles and walk your feet forward, leaning back with a straight body and arms.
Pull your chest to your hands, elbows close to your ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blades, then lower slowly.
Walk your feet further forward to make it harder.
exercises.cue: Your body stays as rigid as a plank.
exercises.avoid: Hips sagging as you pull.

exercises.name: Barbell row
steps: Hold the bar with a shoulder-width grip and hinge forward to about 45 degrees, back flat.
Row the bar to your belly button.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
Lower with control.
exercises.cue: Torso stays still; don't heave the weight.
exercises.avoid: Standing up as you row.

exercises.name: Chin-up
steps: Hang from the bar with palms facing you, hands shoulder-width.
Pull your shoulders down, then pull until your chin clears the bar.
Lower all the way to straight arms.
exercises.cue: Use a band looped on the bar under your knees for help if needed.
exercises.avoid: Half reps.

exercises.name: Band face pull
steps: Anchor the band at head height and hold an end in each hand, palms facing down.
Step back until there's tension.
Pull the band toward your face, elbows high and wide, ending with hands beside your ears.
Return slowly.
exercises.cue: Finish like a double-biceps pose.
exercises.avoid: Leaning back to pull.

exercises.name: Hanging knee raise
steps: Hang from the bar with straight arms.
Brace your core and lift your knees toward your chest, curling your pelvis up.
Lower slowly without swinging.
exercises.cue: Curl your hips, don't just lift your knees.
exercises.avoid: Swinging to get momentum.

exercises.name: Toes-to-bar
steps: Hang from the bar with straight arms.
Pull down on the bar slightly and raise your legs, keeping them as straight as you can.
Touch your toes to the bar.
Lower under control.
exercises.cue: Press the bar down toward your hips as your feet go up.
exercises.avoid: Big uncontrolled swings.

exercises.name: Stability ball rollout
steps: Kneel with your forearms on a stability ball in front of you.
Roll the ball forward, straightening your body from knees to shoulders.
Go only as far as you can without your lower back arching.
Pull back to the start using your abs.
exercises.cue: Tuck your tailbone slightly the whole time.
exercises.avoid: Lower back sagging.

exercises.name: Stir the pot
steps: Get into a plank with your forearms on a stability ball and feet wide.
Draw small circles with your forearms, like stirring a pot.
Do all circles one way, then reverse.
exercises.cue: Small circles, still hips.
exercises.avoid: Hips swaying with the ball.

exercises.name: Ring or TRX fallout
steps: Hold the handles at hip height with straight arms and lean forward slightly.
Slowly let your arms rise overhead as your body leans forward in a straight line.
Go only as far as you can without arching your back.
Pull your arms back down to return.
exercises.cue: Keep your ribs tucked and glutes squeezed.
exercises.avoid: Lower back sagging at the bottom.

exercises.name: Rope pull to stand
steps: Sit on the floor at the base of the rope, legs straight out in front of you.
Grab the rope overhead and pull yourself up hand over hand until you're standing.
Walk your hands back down the rope to lower yourself to the floor with control.
Use as little leg help as you can.
exercises.cue: Pull with your back, elbows driving down toward your ribs.
exercises.avoid: Jerking yourself up with your legs.

exercises.name: Rope climb with foot lock
steps: Reach high and grab the rope, then lift your knees and wrap the rope around one shin and over the top of that foot.
Pinch the rope with your other foot on top to lock it, then stand up on the lock.
Reach higher, lift your knees, re-lock and stand again.
Climb only as high as you're comfortable, then come down hand over hand. Don't slide down.
exercises.cue: Your legs do most of the climbing; your arms just hold on and reach.
exercises.avoid: Sliding down, which burns your hands.

exercises.name: Legless rope climb
steps: Grab the rope as high as you can from standing or seated.
Pull yourself up hand over hand, legs hanging or held in an L.
Climb only as high as you can safely come back down.
Descend hand over hand under control.
exercises.cue: Short, quick reaches.
exercises.avoid: Overreaching and losing your grip.

exercises.name: Sled push
steps: Grip the sled's high or low handles with your arms straight and body leaning in at about 45 degrees.
Drive the sled forward with short, powerful steps, pushing through the balls of your feet.
Keep your hips low and your back flat.
Rest at the end, then push back the other way.
exercises.cue: Load it so you can keep moving without stopping.
exercises.avoid: Hips rising up so you're pushing with your arms.

exercises.name: Backward sled drag
steps: Attach straps or a rope to the sled and hold them with straight arms, facing the sled.
Sit into a quarter squat and lean back slightly.
Walk backward with small steps, pushing through the front of each foot.
Keep constant tension on the straps.
exercises.cue: Knee-friendly quad work. Stay low the whole way.
exercises.avoid: Standing up tall and pulling with your arms.

exercises.name: Sled row walk
steps: Hold the sled straps facing the sled and walk back until they're tight.
Row the straps to your ribs, then take a step or two back.
Repeat: row, step, row, step, the full length.
exercises.cue: Squeeze your shoulder blades on every row.
exercises.avoid: Leaning back instead of rowing.

exercises.name: Landmine squat
steps: Hold the end of the barbell at your chest with both hands, elbows tucked.
Stand with feet shoulder-width, leaning slightly into the bar.
Squat as deep as you can with your heels down.
Drive up through your whole foot.
exercises.cue: The angle lets you sit back and stay upright.
exercises.avoid: Letting the bar pull you forward.

exercises.name: Single-leg landmine RDL
steps: Stand beside the end of the bar, holding it in the hand opposite your standing leg.
Hinge forward at the hips, letting your free leg extend behind you.
Lower until you feel a strong hamstring stretch.
Squeeze your glute to stand. Finish all reps, then switch.
exercises.cue: The landmine makes balance easier than a free dumbbell.
exercises.avoid: Rounding your back.

exercises.name: Landmine reverse lunge
steps: Hold the end of the bar at your chest with both hands.
Step one foot back and lower until both knees are about 90 degrees.
Drive through your front foot to return.
Alternate legs.
exercises.cue: Keep the bar tight to your chest.
exercises.avoid: Front knee caving in.

exercises.name: Half-kneeling landmine press
steps: Kneel on your right knee, left foot forward, holding the bar end at your right shoulder.
Squeeze your right glute and brace your core.
Press the bar up and forward until your arm is straight.
Lower to your shoulder. Finish all reps, then switch.
exercises.cue: A shoulder-friendly press; let your shoulder blade move with the bar.
exercises.avoid: Leaning back or twisting to finish.

exercises.name: Landmine T-bar row
steps: Straddle the bar facing the end. Hook a V-handle under the bar or hold it with both hands.
Hinge forward to about 45 degrees with a flat back.
Row the bar end to your chest.
Lower under control.
exercises.cue: Chest up, elbows close.
exercises.avoid: Standing up to swing the weight.

exercises.name: Meadows row
steps: Stand side-on to the end of the bar in a staggered stance, front forearm resting on your front knee.
Grip the thick end of the bar with an overhand grip.
Row it up and back toward your hip, elbow flaring slightly.
Lower slowly. Finish all reps, then switch.
exercises.cue: Big stretch at the bottom, big squeeze at the top.
exercises.avoid: Rotating your torso to lift.

exercises.name: Landmine rainbows
steps: Stand facing the bar, holding the end overhead with both hands and straight arms.
Keeping your arms straight, lower the bar in an arc down toward one hip.
Bring it back up over your head and down to the other hip.
Pivot your back foot as you turn.
exercises.cue: Your hips and shoulders turn together.
exercises.avoid: Bending your elbows or twisting only your lower back.

exercises.name: Landmine split push press
steps: Stand in a split stance holding the bar end at one shoulder, same-side foot back.
Dip your knees slightly.
Drive explosively through your legs and punch the bar up and forward.
Lower to your shoulder under control and reset. Finish all reps, then switch.
exercises.cue: Power comes from the leg drive; the arm finishes it.
exercises.avoid: Pressing slowly with just your arm.

exercises.name: Sandbag bear-hug squat
steps: Hug the sandbag tight against your chest, arms wrapped around it.
Stand with feet shoulder-width, toes slightly out.
Squat as deep as you can with your chest up.
Drive up through your whole foot.
exercises.cue: Squeeze the bag hard; it trains your upper back too.
exercises.avoid: Letting the bag sag and pull you forward.

exercises.name: Sandbag bear-hug carry
steps: Pick up the bag and hug it high against your chest.
Stand tall and brace your core.
Walk with short, steady steps for the whole time.
exercises.cue: Breathe behind your brace; don't hold your breath the whole walk.
exercises.avoid: Leaning back to balance the load.

exercises.name: Ground to shoulder (sandbag or slam ball)
steps: Stand over the bag or ball, feet shoulder-width. Squat down and wrap your arms around it.
Stand up explosively, driving your hips forward and pulling the load up your body.
As it rises, turn and pop it onto one shoulder.
Let it slide back down in front of you, lower it to the floor and repeat to the other shoulder.
exercises.cue: Hips do the lifting; your arms just steer it.
exercises.avoid: Rounding your back to curl the load up.

exercises.name: Over-the-shoulder toss
steps: Stand over a sandbag or heavy slam ball, feet shoulder-width.
Squat down, grab it and roll it onto your thighs.
Stand up explosively and throw it over one shoulder behind you.
Turn around, walk to it and repeat over the other shoulder.
exercises.cue: Explode through your hips; the throw is a jump without leaving the floor.
exercises.avoid: Throwing with your arms and lower back. Check that the space behind you is clear.

exercises.name: Rotational ball slam
steps: Hold a slam ball overhead with feet shoulder-width.
Rotate and slam it into the floor just outside your right foot, pivoting your back foot.
Pick it up with a squat, return overhead, and slam outside your left foot.
Keep alternating.
exercises.cue: Turn your hips, not just your arms.
exercises.avoid: Rounding your back to pick up the ball.

exercises.name: Sledgehammer tire strikes
steps: Stand facing a tire, a little more than an arm-and-hammer length away, feet shoulder-width.
Hold the handle with one hand at the very end and the other near the head.
Swing it up over one shoulder, then slide your top hand down the handle as you bring it down onto the tire, bending your knees and hinging your hips.
Let it bounce, reset and swing over the other shoulder.
exercises.cue: Look at your target and make sure nobody is behind or beside you.
exercises.avoid: Striking with straight legs, which puts the load on your back.

exercises.name: Bulgarian split squat + twist + single-leg hop
steps: Set up for a Bulgarian split squat: back foot laces-down on a bench, front foot about two feet ahead, hands clasped at your chest.
Lower until your front thigh is near parallel.
At the bottom, rotate your torso toward your front leg, then back to center.
Drive up hard through the front foot into a small hop, and land softly on the same foot straight into the next rep. Finish all reps, then switch.
exercises.cue: Intermediate: rise onto your front toes instead of hopping. Advanced: hop higher, or hold a light medicine ball for the twist.
exercises.avoid: Front knee caving in on the landing.

exercises.name: Reverse lunge to knee-drive hop
steps: Step your right foot back into a reverse lunge.
Drive up through your left foot and bring your right knee up to hip height.
Hop off your left foot at the top, land softly on it, and step straight back into the next lunge.
Finish all reps, then switch.
exercises.cue: Beginners: skip the hop and rise onto your toes at the top.
exercises.avoid: Rushing the landing. Stick it before the next lunge.

exercises.name: Lateral lunge to skater hop
steps: Step your right foot out wide and sit into a lateral lunge on the right.
Push off the right leg explosively and hop to the left, landing on your left leg.
Stick the landing, then step your left foot wide into a lateral lunge on the left.
Hop back to the right. Keep alternating.
exercises.cue: Load the hip, then explode out of it.
exercises.avoid: Landing on a straight knee.

exercises.name: Burpee
steps: Squat down and put your hands on the floor.
Jump or step your feet back into a plank and lower your chest to the floor.
Push up, then jump or step your feet back to your hands.
Jump up with your arms overhead.
exercises.cue: Beginners: step back and forward and skip the push-up and jump.
exercises.avoid: Hips sagging in the plank.

exercises.name: Burpee to box jump
steps: Stand facing a box and do a burpee: hands down, feet back, chest to the floor, feet back in.
From the squat, jump onto the box and land softly.
Stand tall, then step down.
Go straight into the next burpee.
exercises.cue: Keep the box low enough that tired jumps still land cleanly.
exercises.avoid: Jumping down off the box.

exercises.name: Dumbbell thruster (squat to press)
steps: Hold dumbbells or kettlebells at your shoulders, feet shoulder-width.
Squat down with your chest up.
Drive up hard and use that momentum to press the weights overhead.
Lower them to your shoulders as you sink into the next squat.
exercises.cue: One smooth movement; the legs launch the press.
exercises.avoid: Pausing at the top of the squat and pressing with just your arms.

exercises.name: Landmine squat to press
steps: Hold the end of the bar at your chest with both hands.
Squat down, keeping your chest up.
Drive up and press the bar forward and up until your arms are straight.
Bring it back to your chest as you lower into the next squat.
exercises.cue: Stand up and press in one motion.
exercises.avoid: Leaning back to finish the press.

exercises.name: Romanian deadlift to bent-over row
steps: Hold the weights in front of your thighs.
Hinge into a Romanian deadlift until your torso is at about 45 degrees.
Hold that position and row the weights to your lower ribs.
Lower the weights, then stand tall.
exercises.cue: Your back stays flat through the whole combo.
exercises.avoid: Standing up between the hinge and the row.

exercises.name: Kettlebell swing to goblet squat
steps: Do two kettlebell swings.
On the second swing, let the bell float to chest height and catch it by the horns.
Drop straight into a goblet squat, then stand.
Hike the bell back into the next swing. Two swings plus one squat is one round.
exercises.cue: Catch the bell softly, close to your chest.
exercises.avoid: Pulling the catch up with your arms.

exercises.name: Push-up to renegade row
steps: Get into a plank with your hands on dumbbells, feet wide.
Do one push-up.
Row one dumbbell to your hip, lower it, then row the other.
Push-up plus two rows is one rep.
exercises.cue: Wide feet keep your hips from twisting.
exercises.avoid: Hips rotating as you row.

exercises.name: Man maker
steps: Start in a plank with your hands on dumbbells.
Do a push-up, then row each dumbbell once.
Jump your feet in to a squat and clean the weights to your shoulders.
Stand and press them overhead. Lower and go again.
exercises.cue: Use light dumbbells; the combo adds up fast.
exercises.avoid: Letting form fall apart late in the set.

exercises.name: Turkish get-up
steps: Lie on your back holding a kettlebell straight up in your right hand, right knee bent, left arm and leg out at 45 degrees.
Roll onto your left elbow, then your left hand, keeping your eyes on the bell.
Lift your hips, sweep your left leg under you to a kneel, then stand up.
Reverse every step to lie back down. Finish all reps, then switch.
exercises.cue: Arm straight and vertical the whole time. Practice without weight first.
exercises.avoid: Rushing. This is a slow, controlled move.

exercises.name: Pull-up to hanging knee raise
steps: Hang from the bar with straight arms.
Do one pull-up.
Lower to a full hang and raise your knees to your chest.
Lower your legs with control. That's one rep.
exercises.cue: No swinging between the two parts.
exercises.avoid: Kipping to cheat either move.

exercises.name: Walking lunge with medicine ball twist
steps: Hold a medicine ball at your chest.
Step forward into a lunge.
At the bottom, rotate the ball toward your front leg, then back to center.
Step through into the next lunge and twist the other way.
exercises.cue: Rotate from your upper back, not your knee.
exercises.avoid: Front knee swaying as you twist.

exercises.name: Sandbag clean to reverse lunge
steps: Stand over the sandbag, squat down and grip its handles or sides.
Explode up and pull it to your chest, catching it in a bear hug.
Do one reverse lunge on each leg.
Lower the bag to the floor. That's one rep.
exercises.cue: The clean is a jump that pulls the bag up.
exercises.avoid: Curling the bag up with your arms.

exercises.name: Tire flip + jump-in
steps: Flip the tire: squat, fingers under the edge, chest against it, drive up and push it over.
Walk up to the flipped tire.
Jump into the center and back out over the far side.
Turn around and flip it again.
exercises.cue: Stay low and patient on the flip, fast on the jumps.
exercises.avoid: Rounding your back on the lift.

exercises.name: Barbell complex
steps: Deadlift: stand up with the bar.
Bent-over row: hinge and row.
Hang clean: from mid-thigh, jump and pull the bar up to your shoulders.
Front squat, then push press overhead. Do all five without putting the bar down.
exercises.cue: Use a light weight; the weakest move (usually the press) sets the load.
exercises.avoid: Letting your back round as you tire.

exercises.name: Burpee to pull-up
steps: Stand under the bar and drop into a burpee: hands down, jump your feet back, chest to the floor.
Push up, jump your feet back in and stand.
Jump straight up to the bar and pull your chin over it.
Drop down with soft knees and go straight into the next burpee.
exercises.cue: Use the jump's momentum to start the pull.
exercises.avoid: Crashing down from the bar. Land softly.

exercises.name: Burpee to toes-to-bar
steps: Burpee under the bar: chest to the floor, feet back in, stand.
Jump to the bar and settle into a hang.
Raise your legs and touch your toes to the bar.
Lower your legs, drop down and go into the next burpee.
exercises.cue: Kill the swing before the toes-to-bar, even for a second.
exercises.avoid: Using a wild swing to get your feet up.

exercises.name: Burpee to bar pull-over
steps: Burpee under the bar: chest to the floor, feet back in, stand.
Jump to the bar with an overhand grip.
Pull your chest to the bar while swinging your hips up and over it, ending in a front support on top of the bar with straight arms.
Roll back down to a hang under control, drop and go again.
exercises.cue: Keep the bar tight to your hips; tuck your knees if you need to.
exercises.avoid: Letting your grip loosen as you rotate.

exercises.name: Burpee to rope climb
steps: Do a burpee at the base of the rope.
Stand, jump and grab the rope high.
Climb to the top with a foot lock, or legless if you can.
Come down hand over hand, never sliding, and go into the next burpee.
exercises.cue: Save your grip: let your legs do the climbing.
exercises.avoid: Climbing when your grip is shot. Stop the set instead.

exercises.name: Bar muscle-up
steps: Hang from the bar with a slightly wider-than-shoulder grip.
Swing into a strong hollow, then kick into an arch and snap your hips toward the bar.
Pull the bar to your hips, then lean your chest over it and press to straight arms on top.
Lower under control back to a hang.
exercises.cue: The pull is toward your hips, not your chin.
exercises.avoid: Chicken-winging one arm over at a time.

exercises.name: Ring muscle-up
steps: Hang from the rings with a false grip: the ring sits in your wrist crease.
Pull the rings to your lower chest, keeping them close to your body.
Quickly lean your chest over the rings and drop into the bottom of a dip.
Press out to straight arms, then lower under control.
exercises.cue: Rings stay tight to your body the whole time.
exercises.avoid: Letting the rings drift wide.

exercises.name: Pull-up to toes-to-bar
steps: Hang from the bar.
Do a strict pull-up and lower to a full hang.
Raise your toes to the bar.
Lower your legs with control. That's one rep.
exercises.cue: No kipping. Both halves strict.
exercises.avoid: Swinging between the two parts.

exercises.name: Burpee to broad jump
steps: Do a burpee: chest to the floor, feet back in.
From the squat, swing your arms and jump forward as far as you can.
Land softly in a squat.
Go straight into the next burpee from where you landed.
exercises.cue: Every jump is a max effort, even when you're tired.
exercises.avoid: Landing with straight knees.

exercises.name: Burpee to tuck jump
steps: Do a burpee: chest to the floor, feet back in.
Jump straight up and pull your knees to your chest.
Land softly and go straight into the next burpee.
exercises.cue: Knees up, not feet back.
exercises.avoid: Heavy landings as fatigue sets in.

exercises.name: Over-the-shoulder toss + burpee
steps: Throw a sandbag or slam ball over your shoulder.
Turn, do a burpee over the bag, landing on the far side.
Throw it over the other shoulder.
Burpee over it again. Toss plus burpee is one rep.
exercises.cue: Use a heavy bag. This is meant to hurt.
exercises.avoid: Rounding your back on tired pickups.

exercises.name: Devil press
steps: Put your hands on two dumbbells and do a burpee, chest to the floor.
Jump your feet in, landing with the dumbbells between your feet.
Hinge and swing both dumbbells back, then drive your hips through to snap them overhead in one motion.
Lower them to the floor and go again.
exercises.cue: Hips, not arms, get the dumbbells overhead.
exercises.avoid: Rounding your back at the bottom of the swing.

exercises.name: Hang power clean to push press
steps: Hold the bar at mid-thigh, hinged slightly.
Jump explosively, shrug and pull the bar up, then whip your elbows around to catch it on your shoulders.
Dip your knees and drive the bar overhead with your legs.
Lower to your shoulders, then back to your thighs.
exercises.cue: Two jumps: one to clean, one to press.
exercises.avoid: Reverse-curling the bar up.

exercises.name: Kettlebell snatch
steps: Swing the bell back between your legs with one hand.
Snap your hips forward and pull the bell up close to your body.
As it rises, punch your hand up through the handle so the bell lands softly on the back of your forearm, arm locked overhead.
Let it drop back into the next swing.
exercises.cue: Punch through at the top so it doesn't bang your wrist.
exercises.avoid: Letting the bell arc out wide.

exercises.name: Double kettlebell clean, front squat, press
steps: Clean two kettlebells to the rack position on your chest.
Do a front squat.
Stand and press both bells overhead.
Lower to the rack, then let them swing back down. That's one rep.
exercises.cue: Stay tall in the rack; elbows tight to your ribs.
exercises.avoid: Letting the bells crash onto your forearms.

exercises.name: Sandbag clean, squat and press
steps: Clean the sandbag from the floor to your chest.
Squat with it in a bear hug.
Stand and push it overhead.
Lower it to your chest, then to the floor.
exercises.cue: Heavy bag, fast clean, slow squat.
exercises.avoid: Pressing with a big back arch.

exercises.name: Tire flip + 5 sledgehammer strikes
steps: Flip the tire.
Pick up the sledgehammer and do 5 strikes on the tire, alternating shoulders.
Set the hammer down safely.
Flip again. Flip plus 5 strikes is one rep.
exercises.cue: Keep the hammer well clear of the tire's path.
exercises.avoid: Rushing the strikes and losing control of the hammer.

exercises.name: Sled push + burpees
steps: Push a heavy sled one length.
Do 5 burpees at the end.
Push it back.
Do 5 more burpees. Keep going.
exercises.cue: Heavy enough that the push is slow; burpees fast.
exercises.avoid: Standing up tall during the push.

exercises.name: Shouldered sandbag walking lunge
steps: Shoulder a heavy sandbag.
Walk forward in lunges, back knee kissing the floor.
Switch shoulders halfway.
exercises.cue: Stay tall under the uneven load.
exercises.avoid: Leaning toward the bag.

exercises.name: Wall walk
steps: Lie face down with your feet against a wall.
Push up to a plank and walk your feet up the wall while walking your hands back toward it.
Go until your chest is close to the wall, as vertical as you can control.
Walk back down the same way.
exercises.cue: Squeeze everything; stay in one straight line.
exercises.avoid: Arching your lower back near the top.

exercises.name: Burpee to wall walk
steps: Lie face down with your feet against a wall; do a burpee from there.
Drop back to your chest and immediately walk up the wall into a near-handstand.
Walk back down.
Stand up and repeat.
exercises.cue: Fatigue makes the wall walk dangerous; stop before your arms shake.
exercises.avoid: Rushing the descent.

exercises.name: Wall handstand push-up
steps: Kick up into a handstand facing away from a wall, hands a bit wider than shoulders, heels on the wall.
Lower your head to the floor (use a folded mat), making a tripod with your hands.
Press back to straight arms.
exercises.cue: Tight core; don't let your back arch into the wall.
exercises.avoid: Dropping onto your head.

exercises.name: Clap push-up
steps: Start in a strong push-up position.
Lower under control.
Explode up hard enough to clap your hands.
Catch with soft elbows and go straight into the next rep.
exercises.cue: Stop the set the moment a rep gets slower.
exercises.avoid: Landing on locked elbows.

exercises.name: 4-second squat into jump
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width.
Lower into a squat over a slow 4-count.
Pause for 2 seconds at the bottom.
Explode straight up into a max jump. Land softly and start the next slow descent.
exercises.cue: Slow and controlled down, then as violent as possible up.
exercises.avoid: Bouncing out of the pause.

exercises.name: Squat hold + squat jumps
steps: Sink into a squat with thighs about parallel and hold it.
When the hold ends, go straight into max-effort squat jumps.
Land softly on every rep.
exercises.cue: The hold tires your legs; the jumps teach them to fire anyway.
exercises.avoid: Shallow, sloppy jumps. Rest if you have to.

exercises.name: Slow reverse lunge into switch jump
steps: Step back and lower into a reverse lunge over a slow 4-count.
Hold the bottom for 1 second.
Explode up into a split jump, switching legs in the air.
Land softly and start the next slow lunge on the other leg.
exercises.cue: Stay tall through both halves.
exercises.avoid: Front knee caving on the landing.

exercises.name: Slow pistol squat into single-leg jump
steps: Stand on one leg, the other straight out in front.
Lower into a pistol squat over a 4-count.
Explode up into a single-leg jump.
Land softly on the same leg. Finish all reps, then switch.
exercises.cue: Balance first, speed second.
exercises.avoid: Landing with your knee caving in.

exercises.name: Heavy front squat + box jumps
steps: Do 3 heavy front squats, taking 3 seconds on the way down.
Rack the bar.
Within 20 seconds, do max-height box jumps.
Step down from each jump.
exercises.cue: This is contrast training: the heavy squats prime your legs to jump higher.
exercises.avoid: Letting squat depth or jump quality slip.

exercises.name: Slow Romanian deadlift + broad jumps
steps: Do heavy Romanian deadlifts with a 4-count on the way down.
Set the bar down.
Within 20 seconds, do max-distance broad jumps, sticking each landing.
exercises.cue: Slow hinge, explosive hinge.
exercises.avoid: Rounding your back as the RDLs get heavy.

exercises.name: Slow push-up into plyo push-up
steps: Start in a push-up position.
Lower over a 4-count and pause just above the floor.
Explode up so your hands leave the ground.
Land with soft elbows and start the next slow rep.
exercises.cue: Stay rigid through the pause.
exercises.avoid: Hips sagging during the slow part.

exercises.name: Heavy bench press + med ball chest pass
steps: Do 3 heavy bench presses with a 3-second lowering. Use a spotter or safety arms.
Rack the bar and stand up.
Within 20 seconds, do max-effort chest passes against a wall.
exercises.cue: Heavy and slow, then light and fast.
exercises.avoid: Bouncing the bar off your chest.

exercises.name: Slow-lower pull-up into explosive chest-to-bar
steps: From a hang, pull up as explosively as you can, aiming to touch your chest to the bar.
Lower over a slow 4-count to a full hang.
Pause for a second, then explode again.
exercises.cue: Fast up, slow down.
exercises.avoid: Kipping on the way up.

exercises.name: Heavy sled push + sprint
steps: Push a heavy sled one length with slow, powerful steps.
Leave the sled and immediately sprint the same distance back.
Walk to the sled. That's one round.
exercises.cue: The heavy push primes your stride; the sprint should feel faster than normal.
exercises.avoid: Starting the sprint cold. Build up over the first round.

exercises.name: Barbell push-up
steps: Set a loaded barbell on the floor (or in a rack at hip height to make it easier).
Grip the bar shoulder-width and walk your feet back into a plank.
Lower your chest to the bar, elbows about 45 degrees.
Press back up. Squeeze the bar hard the whole time.
exercises.cue: Gripping a round bar works your forearms and core harder than a flat floor.
exercises.avoid: Letting the bar roll. Use big plates so it stays put.

exercises.name: Barbell rollout
steps: Load a barbell with round plates and kneel behind it, hands on the bar shoulder-width.
Brace and roll the bar forward, letting your hips follow, until your body is nearly flat.
Stop before your lower back arches.
Pull the bar back to your knees using your abs. Advanced: do them from your feet.
exercises.cue: Tuck your tailbone and keep your ribs down.
exercises.avoid: Lower back sagging at the far point.

exercises.name: Barbell suitcase deadlift
steps: Stand beside a loaded barbell, feet hip-width, the bar's center next to your right foot.
Squat down and grip the exact middle of the bar with your right hand.
Stand up without leaning or letting the bar tip.
Lower with control. Finish all reps, then switch.
exercises.cue: The bar will try to tip and pull you sideways; your grip and core stop it.
exercises.avoid: Leaning away from the bar.

exercises.name: Burpee over the bar
steps: Stand beside a barbell on the floor, parallel to it.
Do a burpee, chest to the floor.
Jump your feet in, then jump sideways over the bar with both feet.
Land and go straight into the next burpee on the other side.
exercises.cue: Keep the bar low to the floor with small plates.
exercises.avoid: Clipping the bar with your feet.

exercises.name: Barbell devil press
steps: Grip a light barbell on the floor and do a burpee with your hands on the bar, chest to the bar.
Jump your feet in behind the bar.
Explode up and pull the bar from the floor to overhead in one motion (a power snatch), or clean it and press it if that's easier.
Lower it to the floor and go again.
exercises.cue: Keep the weight light; speed and hips move it.
exercises.avoid: Rounding your back pulling the bar off the floor.

exercises.name: Barbell thruster
steps: Hold the bar in the front rack on your shoulders.
Front squat below parallel.
Drive up hard and let the momentum carry the bar overhead.
Lower it to your shoulders as you drop into the next squat.
exercises.cue: The legs press the bar; your arms just finish.
exercises.avoid: Elbows dropping at the bottom.

exercises.name: Barbell burpee complex
steps: Deadlift the bar, then lower it to the floor.
With your hands on the bar, jump your feet back into a burpee (chest to the bar), then do one push-up on the bar.
Jump in, power clean the bar to your shoulders and strict press it overhead.
Lower to the front rack and do a front squat. Lower the bar to the floor. That's one round.
exercises.cue: Light bar. The complex gets heavier with every round.
exercises.avoid: Pulling the clean with a rounded back.

exercises.name: Bear complex
steps: Power clean the bar to your shoulders.
Front squat, then push press overhead.
Lower the bar onto your back, back squat, then push press from behind your neck.
Lower to your thighs, then the floor. That's one round; don't rest between moves.
exercises.cue: A classic barbell complex. Pick a weight you'd clean for about 10.
exercises.avoid: Rushing the bar down behind your neck.

exercises.name: Barbell overhead walking lunge
steps: Press or snatch a light barbell overhead with a wide grip, arms locked.
Walk forward in lunges, back knee kissing the floor.
Keep the bar stacked over your shoulders and hips.
exercises.cue: Squeeze the bar apart to lock your shoulders.
exercises.avoid: The bar drifting forward.

exercises.name: Barbell corner rainbows
steps: Wedge one end of a barbell into a room corner, padded with a towel. Stand facing the other end.
Hold the bar end overhead with both hands and straight arms.
Lower it in an arc to one hip, pivoting your back foot, then back overhead and down to the other hip.
exercises.cue: Hips and shoulders rotate together. Works like a landmine when you don't have one.
exercises.avoid: Bending your elbows or twisting only through your lower back.

exercises.name: Barbell rotational push press
steps: Wedge one end of the bar in a padded corner. Stand side-on, holding the free end at your rear shoulder.
Load your back hip by turning slightly away.
Explode: pivot your back foot, drive your hips around and punch the bar up and forward.
Return under control. Finish all reps, then switch.
exercises.cue: The power comes from the hip turn, like throwing a punch.
exercises.avoid: Pressing with just your arm.

exercises.name: Barbell back-rack lunge with rotation
steps: Take a light barbell on your back.
Step back into a reverse lunge.
At the bottom, slowly rotate your torso toward your front leg, then back to center.
Drive up to standing and alternate legs.
exercises.cue: Keep the rotation slow and controlled with a light bar.
exercises.avoid: Fast twisting under load.

exercises.name: Banded push-up
steps: Loop a resistance band across your upper back and hold one end under each hand.
Get into a push-up position; the band should be tight at the top.
Lower your chest to the floor.
Press up hard against the band and lock out.
exercises.cue: The band makes the top of the rep hardest, where push-ups are usually easy.
exercises.avoid: Hips sagging as you fight the band.

exercises.name: Banded plyo push-up
steps: Set up a banded push-up with the band across your upper back.
Lower under control.
Explode up hard enough that your hands leave the floor.
Catch with soft elbows.
exercises.cue: Short set, maximum effort.
exercises.avoid: Landing on locked elbows.

exercises.name: Hanging kettlebell bench press
steps: Hang a kettlebell from each end of an empty barbell with a resistance band.
Lie on the bench and unrack the bar; it will shake and swing.
Lower slowly to your chest, keeping it level and still.
Press up under control. Use a spotter or safety arms.
exercises.cue: Go light. The goal is control, not weight.
exercises.avoid: Letting one side dip.

exercises.name: Hanging kettlebell back squat
steps: Hang a kettlebell from each end of a barbell with a resistance band and set it in the rack.
Take the bar on your back and step out slowly while the bells settle.
Squat with a slow 3-count down, keeping the bar level.
Stand up smoothly. Rack it carefully.
exercises.cue: Move slowly; fast moves make the bells swing more.
exercises.avoid: Rushing the walk-out.

exercises.name: Hanging kettlebell overhead carry
steps: Hang a kettlebell from each end of a barbell with a resistance band.
Press the bar overhead with a wide grip and lock your arms.
Walk slowly, keeping the bar level and the bells as still as possible.
exercises.cue: Brace everything; your whole body is fighting the wobble.
exercises.avoid: Arching your back to balance the bar.

exercises.name: Bottoms-up kettlebell press
steps: Clean a kettlebell so it's upside down, bell on top, handle in a crush grip at your shoulder.
Brace and press it overhead, keeping the bell balanced.
Lower slowly to your shoulder. Finish all reps, then switch.
exercises.cue: Squeeze the handle hard; that's what keeps it upright.
exercises.avoid: Letting your wrist bend back.

exercises.name: BOSU push-up
steps: Flip a BOSU dome-side down and grip its edges.
Walk your feet back into a push-up position with the platform level.
Lower your chest to the platform without letting it tilt.
Press up.
exercises.cue: Keep the platform level the whole time.
exercises.avoid: Letting the platform rock side to side.

exercises.name: Stability ball push-up
steps: Put your hands on the sides of a stability ball, feet on the floor behind you.
Brace your core to keep the ball still.
Lower your chest to the ball.
Press up.
exercises.cue: Squeeze the ball inward with your hands.
exercises.avoid: The ball rolling out from under you.

exercises.name: BOSU flat-side squat
steps: Flip the BOSU dome-side down and carefully step onto the platform, feet at the edges.
Find your balance, then squat slowly.
Stand up while keeping the platform level.
exercises.cue: Get on and off slowly; hold something nearby while you learn it.
exercises.avoid: Jumping onto or off the BOSU.

exercises.name: Ring support hold
steps: Set the rings about hip height and jump or press up to straight arms.
Turn the rings slightly out, arms locked, shoulders pushed down.
Hold as still as possible.
exercises.cue: Squeeze the rings into your sides.
exercises.avoid: Shoulders shrugging up.

exercises.name: Dead hang
steps: Grab the bar with an overhand grip, hands shoulder-width.
Hang with straight arms and relaxed legs.
Hold for the full time.
exercises.cue: Squeeze the bar like you're trying to crush it.
exercises.avoid: Dropping without warning. Step down under control.

exercises.name: Towel hang
steps: Drape two towels over the bar, shoulder-width apart.
Grab one towel in each hand and hang.
Hold for the full time.
exercises.cue: Thick, soft grips are brutally hard; that's the point.
exercises.avoid: Letting the towels slide through your hands.

exercises.name: Alternating one-arm hang
steps: Hang from the bar with both hands.
Let go with one hand and hang from the other for the full time.
Grab back on, then switch hands.
exercises.cue: Keep your shoulder slightly engaged; don't hang loose.
exercises.avoid: Twisting and swinging.

exercises.name: Towel pull-up
steps: Drape two towels over the bar and grab one in each hand.
Pull until your hands reach your chin.
Lower all the way.
exercises.cue: Grip first, then pull.
exercises.avoid: Short, jerky reps.

exercises.name: Plate pinch hold
steps: Hold two weight plates together, smooth sides out, pinched between your fingers and thumb.
Hold them at your side, arm straight.
Switch hands halfway.
exercises.cue: Use smooth plates; start light and build up.
exercises.avoid: Holding them over your feet. Stand clear.

exercises.name: Heavy barbell hold
steps: Set a heavy barbell in the rack at mid-thigh height.
Grip it overhand, stand up and step back.
Hold it with straight arms and a tall chest for the full time.
Step in and rack it.
exercises.cue: Double overhand only; no hook grip or straps.
exercises.avoid: Letting your shoulders round forward.

exercises.name: Bottoms-up kettlebell carry
steps: Hold a kettlebell upside down by the handle at shoulder height.
Walk slowly, keeping it balanced.
Switch hands halfway.
exercises.cue: Crush the handle; any softness and it tips.
exercises.avoid: Letting your wrist bend back.

exercises.name: Rope hang
steps: Grab the climbing rope with both hands, one above the other.
Lift your feet and hang for the full time.
exercises.cue: Swap which hand is on top each set.
exercises.avoid: Sliding down.

exercises.name: Sledgehammer levers
steps: Hold the sledgehammer at the very end of the handle, arm by your side, head pointing forward.
Using only your wrist, raise the head up toward your nose.
Lower slowly. Choke up on the handle to make it easier.
exercises.cue: Slow on the way down.
exercises.avoid: Bending your elbow to help.

exercises.name: Partner med ball chest pass
steps: Stand facing your partner about 10 feet (3 m) apart.
Throw the ball as hard as you can from your chest, stepping into the throw.
Your partner catches with soft elbows and throws it straight back.
exercises.cue: Fast, violent throws. Step back to add distance as you warm up.
exercises.avoid: Lobbing it. Every throw is a max effort.

exercises.name: Partner rotational toss
steps: Stand side-by-side with your partner, about 10 feet (3 m) apart, both facing the same way.
Load the ball at your outside hip.
Rotate your hips and throw it across your body to your partner.
They catch at their hip, load and throw back. Switch sides after all reps.
exercises.cue: The throw comes from your back hip.
exercises.avoid: Throwing with just your arms.

exercises.name: Partner sit-up and throw
steps: Sit facing your partner, knees bent, feet touching or interlocked.
Both lie back. One holds the ball at their chest.
Sit up together, and the one with the ball throws it to the other at the top.
Both lie back, sit up and throw it back.
exercises.cue: Stay in sync; the throw happens at the top of the sit-up.
exercises.avoid: Yanking your neck forward.

exercises.name: Back-to-back ball pass
steps: Sit back-to-back with your partner, knees bent, feet lifted if you can.
Twist to hand the ball to your partner on one side.
They twist to take it, pass it around to the other side, and you take it back.
Switch direction halfway.
exercises.cue: Full rotation each time; get the ball all the way around.
exercises.avoid: Just reaching with your arms.

exercises.name: Partner leg throw-downs
steps: Lie on your back and hold your partner's ankles as they stand behind your head.
Raise your legs to their hands.
They push your legs down toward the floor, straight or off to one side.
Stop your legs before they touch the floor and bring them back up. Switch roles after the set.
exercises.cue: Push-downs should be firm but controllable.
exercises.avoid: Lower back arching off the floor.

exercises.name: Plank high-fives
steps: Get into high planks facing your partner, heads about 2 feet apart.
At the same time, both lift your right hands and high-five.
Put it down, then high-five with your left.
Keep your hips as still as possible.
exercises.cue: Wider feet make it more stable.
exercises.avoid: Hips rocking side to side.

exercises.name: High-five push-ups
steps: Get into plank positions facing your partner, heads about 2 feet apart.
Do a push-up together.
At the top, both high-five with one hand.
Next rep, high-five with the other hand.
exercises.cue: Stay in sync; the high-five is your pace-setter.
exercises.avoid: Hips sagging while you reach.

exercises.name: Wheelbarrow walk
steps: Get into a push-up position while your partner holds your ankles at hip height.
Walk forward on your hands while they follow.
Keep your body in a straight line; they should hold, not push.
Switch roles at the end.
exercises.cue: Holding just above the knees makes it easier.
exercises.avoid: Hips sagging toward the floor.

exercises.name: Wheelbarrow walk + push-ups
steps: Your partner holds your ankles in a wheelbarrow position.
Do 3 push-ups.
Walk forward 3 hand steps.
Repeat for the full length, then switch roles.
exercises.cue: Brutal on the shoulders and core. Keep it strict.
exercises.avoid: Your partner walking faster than you can.

exercises.name: Partner towel row
steps: Sit facing each other, legs extended, feet touching. Both hold a towel stretched between you.
One partner rows the towel to their ribs while the other resists, letting their arms extend slowly.
Then reverse: the other partner rows while the first resists.
exercises.cue: The resisting partner controls the difficulty. Make them work.
exercises.avoid: Leaning back instead of pulling with your back.

exercises.name: Rope tug-of-war
steps: Both grab the rope in a wide stance, hips low, facing each other.
On 'go,' pull hard for the full time.
Rest briefly between efforts.
exercises.cue: Low hips and a tall chest win tug-of-war.
exercises.avoid: Pulling with a rounded back.

exercises.name: Partner Nordic hamstring curl
steps: Kneel on a pad with your body upright. Your partner kneels behind you and pins your ankles to the floor.
Keeping a straight line from knees to head, lower yourself forward as slowly as you can.
Catch yourself with your hands in a push-up position when you can't hold it anymore.
Push lightly back up and pull with your hamstrings to return. Switch roles.
exercises.cue: One of the best hamstring exercises there is. Slow is the point.
exercises.avoid: Bending at the hips.

exercises.name: Back-to-back squat
steps: Stand back-to-back with your partner and link arms at the elbows.
Walk your feet forward a little and lean into each other.
Squat down together until your thighs are about parallel.
Push back up together.
exercises.cue: Stay pressed together; you're each other's support.
exercises.avoid: One partner doing all the work.

exercises.name: Wall-sit ball pass
steps: Both sit in a wall sit next to each other, thighs parallel to the floor.
Pass a medicine ball back and forth, each twisting to hand it across.
Hold the wall sit for the full time.
exercises.cue: Don't let your hips creep up.
exercises.avoid: Knees drifting past your toes.

exercises.name: Piggyback squat
steps: Carry your partner piggyback-style, hands under their knees.
Stand tall with your chest up.
Squat as deep as you can with control.
Stand up. Switch roles after the set.
exercises.cue: Only pair up with someone close to your weight.
exercises.avoid: Your partner squeezing your neck. They hold your shoulders.

exercises.name: Piggyback walking lunge
steps: Carry your partner piggyback-style.
Walk forward in lunges, back knee to just above the floor.
Switch roles at the end.
exercises.cue: Short, controlled steps.
exercises.avoid: Leaning forward under the load.

exercises.name: Fireman's carry
steps: Your partner stands facing you. Squat down, put your head beside their hip and your shoulder into their stomach.
Wrap one arm through their legs and grab their wrist.
Stand up with your legs, their weight across your shoulders.
Walk the full length, set them down carefully, and switch.
