exercises.cue: Lift with your legs, flat back. Pair with someone your weight or lighter.
exercises.avoid: Standing up with a rounded back.

exercises.name: Fireman's carry squat + walk
steps: Get your partner into a fireman's carry.
Do 5 squats with them on your shoulders.
Walk one length.
Set them down carefully and switch.
exercises.cue: Beast only. Get the carry position solid before loading squats.
exercises.avoid: Squatting deep with a rounded back.

exercises.name: Burpee high-five jump
steps: Stand facing your partner an arm's length apart.
Both do a burpee at the same time.
Jump up together and high-five at the top.
Land softly and go again.
exercises.cue: Stay in sync; wait for the slower partner.
exercises.avoid: Rushing and landing heavy.

exercises.name: Jump over, crawl under
steps: Your partner holds a high plank.
Jump sideways over their legs, landing softly.
Drop down and crawl back under their body.
Repeat for all reps, then switch roles.
exercises.cue: Your partner's plank gets tough too: they hold while you work.
exercises.avoid: Clipping your partner's legs. Jump high enough to clear them easily.

exercises.name: Burpee over partner
steps: Your partner lies face down or holds a low plank.
Do a burpee beside them.
Jump sideways over them.
Burpee on the other side and jump back. Switch roles after the set.
exercises.cue: Keep the jump well clear of your partner.
exercises.avoid: Landing close to their head or hands.

exercises.name: Mirror drill
steps: Face your partner in an athletic stance, knees bent.
The leader shuffles, jumps, drops and changes direction however they like.
The follower mirrors every move as fast as possible.
Switch leaders.
exercises.cue: Stay low and on the balls of your feet.
exercises.avoid: Crossing your feet as you shuffle.

exercises.name: Band-resisted sprint
steps: Loop a heavy band around your waist. Your partner stands behind holding the other end.
Lean forward and sprint about 10 yards (10 m) while your partner resists, letting you move.
Walk back and switch roles.
exercises.cue: Drive your knees and pump your arms; stay leaning forward.
exercises.avoid: Your partner holding so hard that you can't move.

exercises.name: Partner tire flip + jump-through
steps: One partner flips the tire.
As soon as it lands flat, the other partner jumps into the center and out the far side.
Switch roles each flip and keep moving down the floor.
exercises.cue: The flipper calls it; the jumper waits until the tire is flat and still.
exercises.avoid: Jumping in before the tire has settled.

exercises.name: Sledgehammer + burpee relay
steps: Partner A does 10 sledgehammer strikes on the tire.
At the same time, Partner B does burpees until A finishes.
Switch roles. That's one round.
Keep the burpee partner well clear of the hammer's path.
exercises.cue: Your partner's work is your clock, so push the pace.
exercises.avoid: Standing close to the tire while someone swings.

exercises.name: Deep parallette push-up
steps: Set two parallettes shoulder-width apart and grip them, walking your feet back into a plank.
Lower your chest below the level of your hands.
Press back up to straight arms.
exercises.cue: The extra depth stretches the chest; control the bottom.
exercises.avoid: Hips sagging.

exercises.name: Parallette dips
steps: Use your tallest parallettes, set about shoulder-width apart. Press up to straight arms, legs bent or out in front.
Lower until your shoulders are just below your elbows.
Press back up to locked arms.
exercises.cue: Lean slightly forward for more chest, stay upright for more triceps.
exercises.avoid: Shoulders rolling forward at the bottom.

exercises.name: Elevated pike push-up on parallettes
steps: Grip parallettes and put your feet on a box so your hips are stacked high over your hands.
Lower your head between the parallettes, below hand height.
Press back up.
exercises.cue: The closer to vertical, the closer to a handstand push-up.
exercises.avoid: Letting your hips drift back.

exercises.name: Tuck planche hold
steps: Grip parallettes and lean your shoulders forward past your hands.
Tuck your knees to your chest and lift your feet off the floor.
Hold with straight arms and a rounded upper back.
exercises.cue: Push the parallettes away and lean further as you get stronger.
exercises.avoid: Bending your elbows.

exercises.name: Parallette knee tucks
steps: Press up to straight arms on the parallettes, feet on the floor in front of you.
Lift your feet and pull your knees toward your chest.
Lower with control without touching down, then repeat.
exercises.cue: Push your shoulders down away from your ears.
exercises.avoid: Shrugging and sinking into your shoulders.

exercises.name: L-sit hold
steps: Press up on the parallettes with locked arms.
Lift your legs straight out in front of you, level with the floor.
Hold. Bend your knees (tuck sit) if needed to finish the time.
exercises.cue: Squeeze your quads and point your toes.
exercises.avoid: Letting your shoulders shrug up.

exercises.name: Parallette leg lifts
steps: Press up on the parallettes into a support hold.
Keeping your legs straight, lift them to an L.
Lower until your heels nearly touch the floor, then lift again.
exercises.cue: Slow down, controlled up.
exercises.avoid: Swinging your legs for momentum.

exercises.name: Parallette swing-throughs
steps: Start in a plank with your hands on tall parallettes.
Lift your hips and swing your legs through between the bars into an L-sit.
Swing them back out to the plank.
Keep your arms locked the whole time.
exercises.cue: Lift your hips high to create room.
exercises.avoid: Catching your heels on the floor.

exercises.name: Push-up + swing-through to L-sit
steps: Start in a plank on tall parallettes and do a deep push-up.
Swing your legs through into an L-sit and hold for 2 seconds.
Swing back out to the plank. That's one rep.
exercises.cue: Beast gymnastics. Control beats speed.
exercises.avoid: Bending your arms during the swing.

exercises.name: Seated box jump
steps: Sit on a low box facing a taller box, feet flat.
Swing your arms and jump from seated straight onto the tall box without rocking forward first.
Land softly, step down and sit again.
exercises.cue: No momentum: pure starting power.
exercises.avoid: Rocking forward before the jump.

exercises.name: Single-leg box jump
steps: Stand on one leg facing a low box.
Swing your arms and jump onto the box, landing on the same leg.
Stick the landing, step down and repeat. Switch legs.
exercises.cue: Use a low box; landing control is the challenge.
exercises.avoid: Knee caving on landing.

exercises.name: Lateral box jumps
steps: Stand beside a low box.
Jump sideways onto it, landing with both feet.
Step or hop down on the other side and jump back on from that side.
exercises.cue: Stay tall and land in the middle of the box.
exercises.avoid: Landing on the box edge.

exercises.name: Box jump-over
steps: Face a low-to-medium box.
Jump onto it, then immediately jump off the far side.
Turn around and go back the other way.
exercises.cue: Touch the top of the box with both feet on each pass.
exercises.avoid: Rushing into a sloppy far-side landing.

exercises.name: Depth drop to broad jump
steps: Stand on a low box.
Step off, land on both feet.
Immediately jump forward as far as you can.
Stick the landing, walk back and reset.
exercises.cue: Short ground contact, long jump.
exercises.avoid: Absorbing too deep before the jump.

exercises.name: Depth jump to box jump
steps: Set a low box and a taller box about 3 feet (1 m) apart.
Step off the low box.
As soon as you land, jump onto the taller box.
Step down and reset.
exercises.cue: The rebound should be instant, like the floor is hot.
exercises.avoid: A tall box that makes you tuck your knees to make it.

exercises.name: Box step-up into jump
steps: Put one foot on a knee-height box.
Drive through that foot and explode up, driving the other knee high and leaving the box.
Land softly on the same foot on the box, then step back down.
Finish all reps, then switch.
exercises.cue: The box leg does all the work.
exercises.avoid: Pushing off the floor leg.

exercises.name: Deficit reverse lunge
steps: Stand on a low box or step.
Step one foot back off the box and lower your back knee toward the floor.
The deficit gives your front leg a deeper range.
Drive back up onto the box. Alternate legs.
exercises.cue: Slow on the way down.
exercises.avoid: Front heel lifting.

exercises.name: Single-leg hip thrust on box
steps: Sit on the floor with your upper back against a box or bench.
Plant one foot and lift the other.
Drive your hips up until level, squeezing your glute.
Lower. Finish all reps, then switch.
exercises.cue: Chin tucked; ribs down.
exercises.avoid: Arching your lower back.

exercises.name: Seated box leg raises
steps: Sit on the edge of a box, hands gripping the edge beside your hips.
Lean back slightly and extend your legs out straight.
Pull your knees to your chest, then extend again without touching the floor.
exercises.cue: Keep your chest lifted.
exercises.avoid: Collapsing your upper back.

exercises.name: Stepping-stone boxes
steps: Setup: line up 3 or 4 low boxes about 3 feet (1 m) apart.
Jump onto the first box, step down the far side.
Jump onto the next box, step down, and so on to the end.
Walk back to the start; that's one run.
exercises.cue: Stick every landing before you move on.
exercises.avoid: Rushing and landing on box edges.

exercises.name: Parallette hurdle line
steps: Setup: line up 4 to 6 low parallettes as hurdles, about 3 feet (1 m) apart.
Two-foot hop over each one in a row with no pause between.
At the end, turn and hop back sideways over each one.
That's one run.
exercises.cue: Quick, springy contacts. Tuck your knees to clear the bars.
exercises.avoid: Clipping a hurdle. Use lower ones or space them wider.

exercises.name: Bear crawl + hurdle course
steps: Setup: a line of 4 low parallettes about 3 feet (1 m) apart.
Bear crawl forward, weaving between the parallettes.
At the end, turn and two-foot hop back over each one.
That's one run.
exercises.cue: Knees low in the crawl, feet quick on the hops.
exercises.avoid: Hips high in the crawl.

exercises.name: Zig-zag to box finish
steps: Setup: stagger 4 parallettes in a zig-zag, then a medium box at the end.
Hop diagonally over each parallette, left to right to left.
Finish with a box jump onto the box.
Step down and walk back. That's one run.
exercises.cue: Face straight down the course the whole time and let your feet travel diagonally. Don't turn your hips toward each hop.
exercises.avoid: Losing rhythm before the box. Take a reset step if needed.

exercises.name: Up and over
steps: Setup: box, parallette, box, parallette, about 4 feet (1.2 m) apart. Use low-to-medium boxes.
Jump onto the first box.
Jump off forward over the parallette, landing on both feet.
Rebound straight onto the next box and repeat to the end.
exercises.cue: Think one continuous flow: up, over, up, over.
exercises.avoid: Landing close enough to hit the next obstacle.

exercises.name: Vault and hurdle course
steps: Setup: a knee-height box, then 3 low parallettes in a line.
Safety vault over the box: hands on top, swing one leg over, then the other, and land running.
Two-foot hop over the 3 parallettes.
Jog back. That's one run.
exercises.cue: Plant your hands firmly before you commit to the vault.
exercises.avoid: Vaulting a box that isn't stable.

exercises.name: Box-to-box precision jumps
steps: Setup: 3 or 4 boxes of the same height in a line, about 2 to 3 feet apart. Start low.
Jump onto the first box.
Jump from the top of one box to the top of the next, sticking each landing.
Step down at the end. That's one run.
exercises.cue: Land on the balls of your feet in the middle of the box, knees soft.
exercises.avoid: Adding distance or height before your landings are silent.

exercises.name: Depth chain
steps: Setup: low box, parallette, medium box, parallette, low box, each about 4 feet (1.2 m) apart.
Step off the first box and rebound instantly over the parallette.
Land and jump straight onto the medium box.
Step off, rebound over the next parallette and finish on the last box.
exercises.cue: Every floor contact is a quick bounce.
exercises.avoid: Sinking deep on the rebounds.

exercises.name: Single-leg hurdle hops
steps: Setup: 4 of your lowest parallettes about 2 feet (60 cm) apart.
Hop over each one on one leg.
Walk back and do the next run on the other leg.
exercises.cue: Low hurdles are enough. Control the landing every time.
exercises.avoid: Knee caving on the landings.

exercises.name: Lateral gauntlet
steps: Setup: make a straight line of a low box, 2 parallettes, then another low box, about 3 feet (1 m) apart. Turn each parallette so its long side faces the start, like a low hurdle.
Stand at one end, sideways to the line, so the course runs out to your right. You travel sideways the whole time, like a defensive shuffle.
Jump sideways onto the first box and off the far side, hop sideways over each parallette, then jump sideways onto the last box and off.
Without turning around, come back the same way with your left side leading. There and back is one run.
exercises.cue: Your chest points the same direction the whole run, toward the side of the course, not toward where you're going. Your right side leads out and your left side leads back.
exercises.avoid: Turning to face the way you're moving, or crossing your feet.

exercises.name: Tire and box course
steps: Setup: a flat tire, then 2 low boxes about 4 feet (1.2 m) apart.
Jump into the tire and out the far side.
Jump onto the first box, step off, jump onto the second.
Step down and jog back.
exercises.cue: Clear the tire rim with room to spare.
exercises.avoid: Clipping the tire.

exercises.name: Kong vault gauntlet
steps: Setup: a low box, then 3 parallettes, then a medium box, with a clear landing zone after.
Kong vault the low box: run up, dive forward, push off the box with both hands and bring your knees through between your arms.
Land running, hop over the 3 parallettes, then jump onto the medium box and stick it.
Practice the kong on its own until it's smooth before running the full course.
exercises.cue: Push the box away hard; your hips should float over.
exercises.avoid: Diving headfirst without a strong push. Clip your toes and you'll fall.

exercises.name: Beast gauntlet
steps: Setup: a box, a parallette, 2 boxes of equal height about 3 feet apart, then a clear floor lane.
Burpee, then box jump onto the first box.
Jump off over the parallette, rebound onto box 2, jump across to box 3 and stick it.
Step off, do 3 broad jumps, then sprint back to the start.
exercises.cue: This is the finale. Slow down before your landings get sloppy.
exercises.avoid: Racing the clock at the cost of clean landings.

exercises.name: BOSU single-leg squat
steps: Stand on one leg in the center of the BOSU dome, the other foot held just off the dome.
Slowly squat as deep as you can control, arms reaching forward.
Stand up without letting the other foot touch down.
Finish all reps, then switch.
exercises.cue: Knee stays over your toes even as the dome wobbles.
exercises.avoid: Knee caving inward.

exercises.name: BOSU pistol squat
steps: Stand on one leg on the center of the dome, the other leg straight out in front.
Lower into a full pistol squat over 3 seconds.
Stand up without touching down.
Finish all reps, then switch.
exercises.cue: Arms forward for counterbalance.
exercises.avoid: Collapsing at the bottom. Stop above the depth you can control.

exercises.name: BOSU single-leg deadlift
steps: Stand on one leg on the dome, holding a kettlebell or dumbbell in the opposite hand.
Hinge forward, free leg extending behind you, until the weight is near the dome.
Squeeze your glute to stand tall without touching down.
Finish all reps, then switch.
exercises.cue: Slow. The wobble is the workout.
exercises.avoid: Rounding your back to reach lower.

exercises.name: Kettlebell swings + BOSU balance hold
steps: Do the kettlebell swings on solid floor.
Park the bell and step straight onto the BOSU dome on one leg.
Hold as still as you can with your heart pounding, then switch legs.
exercises.cue: Balancing while breathing hard is much tougher than balancing fresh.
exercises.avoid: Stepping onto the BOSU with the bell still in your hand.

exercises.name: Light kettlebell swing on BOSU
steps: Flip the BOSU dome-side down. Pick up a light kettlebell (much lighter than your normal swing bell) and step carefully onto the platform, feet near the edges.
Find your balance, hinge and hike the bell back between your legs.
Snap your hips to float it to chest height while keeping the platform level.
Let it fall back into the next swing. Park the bell on the floor before stepping off.
exercises.cue: Light bell, crisp hips. The challenge is keeping the platform still, not moving weight.
exercises.avoid: Going heavier or swinging higher when the platform starts tipping. End the set instead.

exercises.name: Overhead press standing on BOSU
steps: Stand on the dome, feet hip-width, weights at your shoulders.
Brace and press overhead without letting the dome tilt.
Lower slowly.
exercises.cue: Squeeze your glutes; keep your ribs down.
exercises.avoid: Leaning back to finish the press.

exercises.name: BOSU burpee
steps: Hold a BOSU by its edges at your chest, flat side facing you.
Squat and plant it dome-down on the floor, then jump your feet back into a plank on the platform.
Do a push-up on the wobbly platform, then jump your feet back in.
Stand, press the BOSU overhead and jump.
exercises.cue: Keep the platform level in the plank.
exercises.avoid: Planting the BOSU off to one side.

exercises.name: BOSU lateral hop-overs
steps: Stand beside a BOSU, dome up.
Hop sideways onto the dome with both feet.
Stick it, hop off the far side, then come back over.
exercises.cue: Be stable on the dome before you hop off.
exercises.avoid: Landing on the dome's edge.

exercises.name: BOSU squat jumps
steps: Stand on the center of the dome, feet hip-width.
Squat and jump straight up.
Land back on the dome and stick it before the next rep.
exercises.cue: Every landing is a balance test.
exercises.avoid: Chaining reps before you're stable.

exercises.name: BOSU mountain climbers
steps: Flip the BOSU dome-side down and grip its edges in a high plank.
Drive your knees toward your chest one at a time, fast.
Keep the platform level the whole time.
exercises.cue: Shoulders over hands.
exercises.avoid: Platform rocking side to side.

exercises.name: BOSU V-sit with med ball twist
steps: Sit on the dome, lean back and lift your feet so you balance on the dome.
Hold a medicine ball at your chest.
Rotate the ball to one side, then the other, without letting your feet touch down.
exercises.cue: Straighter legs make it harder.
exercises.avoid: Rounding your back and collapsing.

exercises.name: Single-leg BOSU catch
steps: Stand on one leg on the BOSU dome.
Your partner tosses a light ball to you at different heights and sides.
Catch and toss it back without touching down. Switch legs, then roles.
exercises.cue: Partner: make them reach.
exercises.avoid: Tossing so hard it's a fall risk.

exercises.name: Stability ball jackknife
steps: Get into a high plank with your shins on a stability ball.
Pull your knees toward your chest, rolling the ball in.
Extend back to a straight plank.
exercises.cue: Round your back slightly as you pull in.
exercises.avoid: Hips sagging in the plank.

exercises.name: Stability ball pike
steps: Get into a high plank with your toes on a stability ball.
Keeping your legs straight, lift your hips high, rolling the ball toward your hands.
Lower back to a straight plank.
exercises.cue: Shoulders stay stacked over your hands.
exercises.avoid: Bending your knees to cheat.

exercises.name: One-arm TRX plank + kettlebell row
steps: Set a TRX handle a few inches off the floor. Put one hand in it and set up a high plank with feet wide, the other hand on a kettlebell.
Brace hard; the strap hand will want to drift.
Row the kettlebell to your hip without twisting your hips.
Lower and repeat. Finish all reps, then switch hands.
exercises.cue: Press the strap hand straight down to keep it still.
exercises.avoid: Hips rotating toward the rowing side.

exercises.name: TRX pike crunch
steps: Set the straps at mid-shin height, feet in the foot cradles, and walk your hands out into a high plank.
Keeping your legs straight, lift your hips high, pulling your feet toward your hands.
Lower back to a straight plank.
exercises.cue: Shoulders stay over your hands.
exercises.avoid: Hips sagging between reps.

exercises.name: TRX knee tuck
steps: Feet in the foot cradles at mid-shin height, hands on the floor in a high plank.
Pull your knees toward your chest.
Extend back to a straight plank.
exercises.cue: Keep your hips level with your shoulders.
exercises.avoid: Letting the straps swing.

exercises.name: TRX atomic push-up
steps: Feet in the TRX foot cradles, hands on the floor in a high plank.
Do a push-up.
At the top, pull your knees to your chest.
Extend back out. That's one rep.
exercises.cue: Stay rigid in the push-up; the straps will swing if you don't.
exercises.avoid: Hips sagging in the push-up.

exercises.name: TRX body saw
steps: Feet in the foot cradles, forearms on the floor in a plank.
Push your body back so your shoulders move behind your elbows.
Pull forward past the start. Keep rocking back and forth.
exercises.cue: Small range first; bigger as you get stronger.
exercises.avoid: Lower back sagging on the push back.

exercises.name: Bear crawl with wall passes
steps: Set up in a bear crawl, knees an inch off the floor, alongside a wall with a light medicine ball.
Crawl two steps, pushing the ball along with you.
Stop, pick up the ball with your wall-side hand, pass it against the wall and catch it.
Put it down, crawl two more steps and repeat. Turn around to use the other hand.
exercises.cue: Hips stay level and knees stay low while you throw.
exercises.avoid: Hips shooting up when you reach for the ball.

exercises.name: Bear crawl with partner catches
steps: Bear crawl forward, knees an inch off the floor, while your partner walks alongside with a light ball.
After every 2 steps, your partner tosses the ball; catch it one-handed and toss it back.
Keep crawling. Switch roles at the end.
exercises.cue: Partner: vary the height and side of the throws.
exercises.avoid: Dropping your knees to the floor to catch.

exercises.name: Sideways wall ball
steps: Stand side-on to a wall, about 3 feet (1 m) away, ball at your chest.
Squat down.
Drive up, rotate toward the wall and throw the ball high against it.
Catch it, rotate back into the squat. Finish all reps, then switch sides.
exercises.cue: Legs and hips power the throw; arms just steer it.
exercises.avoid: Throwing with only your arms.

exercises.name: GHD hip extension
steps: Set the pad so your hips are just in front of it and hook your heels under the rollers.
Keep your back flat and hinge at the hips, lowering your torso toward the floor.
Squeeze your glutes to lift your body back to straight.
exercises.cue: Hinge from the hips; your back stays flat.
exercises.avoid: Arching your back past straight at the top.

exercises.name: GHD back extension
steps: Set the pad at your upper thighs and hook your heels under the rollers.
Let your spine round forward slowly, one section at a time.
Uncurl back to a straight line, from your lower back up to your head.
exercises.cue: Slow and segmented. Stop at straight.
exercises.avoid: Hyperextending at the top.

exercises.name: Weighted GHD back extension
steps: Set up for a back extension and hug a weight plate or medicine ball to your chest.
Hinge down under control.
Lift back to a straight line, squeezing your glutes and back.
exercises.cue: Start light; add weight once 15 clean reps feel easy.
exercises.avoid: Swinging up with momentum.

exercises.name: Glute-ham raise
steps: Set the pad at your upper thighs, feet pressed against the plate, knees just behind the pad.
Start with your body upright from knees to head.
Lower your torso forward by straightening your knees, as slowly as you can.
Pull yourself back up with your hamstrings. Push off the floor lightly if you need help.
exercises.cue: One of the toughest hamstring moves there is.
exercises.avoid: Bending at the hips.

exercises.name: GHD oblique raise
steps: Lie sideways on the GHD with the pad under your hip and feet locked in.
Lower your torso sideways toward the floor.
Lift back up past straight, crunching your top side.
exercises.cue: Hands crossed on your chest.
exercises.avoid: Twisting instead of bending sideways.

exercises.name: GHD sit-up
steps: Sit on the GHD with the pad under your glutes and your feet locked in, knees slightly bent.
Lean back until your hands touch the floor behind you, arms reaching back.
Drive your knees straight and sit up hard, touching your toes.
exercises.cue: New to GHD sit-ups? Do one short set only. Too many too soon is a known cause of severe muscle breakdown (rhabdo).
exercises.avoid: High volume on your first sessions.

exercises.name: GHD sit-up into wall ball
steps: Set up the GHD with the foot end about 6 feet (2 m) from a wall, facing it.
Hold a light medicine ball at your chest and lean back into the sit-up.
Sit up hard and throw the ball to the wall at the top.
Catch it and lower into the next rep.
exercises.cue: The throw finishes the sit-up. Only for people already comfortable with GHD sit-ups.
exercises.avoid: Using a heavy ball, or doing high reps before you've built up to them.

exercises.name: GHD sit-up with partner toss
steps: Your partner stands facing you in front of the GHD, holding a medicine ball.
Lean back into the sit-up.
As you sit up, your partner tosses you the ball; catch it, throw it straight back.
Lower into the next rep. Switch roles.
exercises.cue: Partner: toss at the top of the sit-up, not before.
exercises.avoid: Same caution as regular GHD sit-ups: build volume slowly.

exercises.name: Box-to-box side plank hold
steps: Set two soft boxes of the same height a body length apart.
Put your forearm (or hand, arm straight) on one box, elbow under your shoulder, and stack your feet on the side of the other box.
Lift your hips so your body is a straight line hanging between the boxes.
Hold, breathing steadily, then switch sides.
exercises.cue: Push the box away with your forearm so your shoulder doesn't sink.
exercises.avoid: Hips sagging into the gap between the boxes.

exercises.name: Box-to-box side plank hip dips
steps: Set two soft boxes of the same height a body length apart.
Forearm or hand on one box under your shoulder, feet stacked on the other box, body straight between them.
Lower your hips toward the floor under control, as far as you can while staying sideways.
Drive your hips back up past straight, squeezing the side of your waist. Finish all reps, then switch sides.
exercises.cue: Slow down, fast up: two seconds to lower, one to lift.
exercises.avoid: Rolling your chest toward the floor as you dip.

exercises.name: Box-to-box side plank thread-through
steps: Set up the box-to-box side plank: hand under your shoulder on one box, feet stacked on the other.
Reach your top arm straight up to the ceiling.
Rotate your chest down and thread that arm under your body toward the far box, keeping your hips high.
Unwind back to the arm-up position. Finish all reps, then switch sides.
exercises.cue: Your hips stay at the same height while your chest rotates.
exercises.avoid: Dropping your hips into the gap as you thread through.

exercises.name: Copenhagen plank on a box
steps: Lie on your side next to a box or bench, forearm on the floor under your shoulder.
Put the inside of your top leg on the box: knee on it to start, ankle for the full version.
Lift your hips and bring your bottom leg up to meet the box, so only your top leg and forearm hold you.
Hold, then switch sides.
exercises.cue: Squeeze the box down with your top leg; that's the inner-thigh work.
exercises.avoid: Going straight to the ankle version; build up from the knee.

exercises.name: Box-to-box star plank hip dips
steps: Set up the box-to-box side plank with your hand on one box and only your bottom foot on the other.
Raise your top leg and top arm into a star.
Dip your hips toward the floor and drive them back up, keeping the star shape.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.
exercises.cue: Keep the top leg high; it makes the bottom side work harder.
exercises.avoid: Letting the bottom foot slide off the box: use a box with a grippy top.

exercises.name: One-arm TRX hang, feet on a box
steps: Shorten the TRX so the handle hangs about arm's length above your chest when you lie under it. Put a box or bench where your heels will go.
Lie belly up, grab the handle with one arm straight, and put your heels on the box.
Pull your hips up until your body is a straight line from heels to shoulders, hanging from one arm. Free arm across your chest or out to the side.
Hold without twisting, then switch arms.
exercises.cue: Keep both hips level: your body will want to spin toward the free side.
exercises.avoid: Shrugging: pull the shoulder of the hanging arm away from your ear.

exercises.name: One-arm TRX hang with slow rotations
steps: Set up the one-arm TRX hang: belly up, heels on a box or bench, one straight arm on the handle, body in a straight line.
Reach your free arm to the ceiling.
Take three seconds to rotate your chest and free arm down toward the floor, keeping your hips up.
Take three seconds to rotate back up, past the start, reaching high. Finish all reps, then switch arms.
exercises.cue: Your upper body turns; your hips stay square and high.
exercises.avoid: Rushing. The slower the rotation, the harder the core works.

exercises.name: One-arm TRX row, feet on a box
steps: Set up the one-arm TRX hang: belly up, heels on a box or bench, one straight arm on the handle.
Pull your chest up to the handle without letting your body twist open.
Lower slowly to a straight arm.
Finish all reps, then switch arms.
exercises.cue: Fight the twist: that's the core half of the exercise.
exercises.avoid: Hips dropping as you get tired.

exercises.name: TRX hamstring curl
steps: Lie on your back with your heels in the TRX foot cradles, straps hanging straight down.
Lift your hips into a straight line from heels to shoulders, arms on the floor.
Keeping your hips up, bend your knees and pull your heels toward your glutes.
Straighten your legs slowly without letting your hips drop.
exercises.cue: Hips stay high the whole time.
exercises.avoid: Sagging at the hips when the legs straighten.

exercises.name: TRX side plank hip dips
steps: Put your feet in the TRX foot cradles, then turn onto your side with your forearm on the floor under your shoulder.
Stack your feet in the straps and lift your hips into a straight line.
Lower your hips toward the floor and drive them back up.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.
exercises.cue: Keep the straps still; they'll swing if your hips wobble.
exercises.avoid: Letting your top shoulder roll forward.

exercises.name: TRX squat + row
steps: Face the anchor holding both handles, arms straight, leaning back slightly.
Squat down, arms staying straight.
Stand up and, as you reach the top, row the handles to your ribs.
Straighten your arms and go straight into the next squat.
exercises.cue: The squat and the row should flow into one movement.
exercises.avoid: Pulling yourself out of the squat with your arms.

exercises.name: TRX power pull
steps: Hold one handle with one hand and lean back, body straight, other arm reaching toward the anchor.
Let your body open toward the floor, free arm reaching down and back.
Row and rotate together: pull your chest up to the handle while the free arm punches toward the anchor.
Lower slowly. Finish all reps, then switch sides.
exercises.cue: Rotate from your upper back, not by bending at the hips.
exercises.avoid: Rushing the lowering phase.

exercises.name: TRX row + Y raise
steps: Hold the handles and lean back with a straight body and arms.
Row your chest to your hands.
Lower back to straight arms, then pull yourself up again with straight arms raised overhead in a Y.
Lower slowly. That's one rep.
exercises.cue: Squeeze your shoulder blades down and back on both halves.
exercises.avoid: Bending your elbows on the Y.

exercises.name: TRX suspended lunge
steps: Face away from the anchor with one foot in both foot cradles behind you.
Lower into a lunge, sliding the back foot back until your front thigh is parallel to the floor.
Drive through the front heel to stand back up.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.
exercises.cue: Keep your weight on the front foot; the back leg is just along for the ride.
exercises.avoid: Front knee caving inward.

exercises.name: TRX suspended lunge + hop
steps: Set up the TRX suspended lunge: back foot in the cradles, facing away from the anchor.
Lunge down under control.
Drive up explosively into a hop on the front leg, swinging your arms up.
Land softly and sink straight into the next lunge. Finish all reps, then switch legs.
exercises.cue: Land quietly on the ball of your foot, then let the heel down.
exercises.avoid: Hopping so high the strap yanks your back leg.

exercises.name: TRX-assisted squat jump
steps: Face the anchor holding both handles, arms straight.
Sit back into a deep squat, using the straps for balance.
Jump up explosively, pulling lightly on the straps to help.
Land softly and sink into the next squat.
exercises.cue: The straps help your balance; your legs do the jumping.
exercises.avoid: Stiff-legged, loud landings.

exercises.name: TRX push-up + side plank
steps: Put your feet in the TRX foot cradles and walk your hands out into a push-up position.
Do one push-up.
At the top, rotate into a side plank on one hand, top arm to the ceiling, feet stacked in the straps.
Return to the push-up position, do another push-up, and rotate to the other side.
exercises.cue: Rotate your whole body as one piece.
exercises.avoid: Hips sagging during the push-up.

exercises.name: Mini-band push-up
steps: Loop a mini band around your wrists or forearms.
Set up a push-up (knees down to make it easier), hands shoulder-width so the band is taut.
Lower your chest to the floor while pushing your hands outward against the band.
Press back up, still pushing outward.
exercises.cue: Pushing out against the band switches on your shoulders and upper back.
exercises.avoid: Letting the band pull your hands and elbows in.

exercises.name: Lying band floor press
steps: Lie on your back with the band across your upper back, under your shoulder blades.
Hold an end in each hand beside your chest, elbows on the floor at about 45 degrees.
Press both hands straight up toward the ceiling.
Lower slowly until your elbows touch the floor.
exercises.cue: Wrap the band around your hands to adjust the tension.
exercises.avoid: Letting the band snap your arms back down.

exercises.name: Lying band pullover
steps: Anchor the band low behind your head, then lie on your back, head toward the anchor.
Hold the band with both hands, arms straight overhead on the floor, band tight.
Keeping your arms straight, pull the band over your face down to your hips.
Return slowly overhead.
exercises.cue: Keep your lower back pressed to the floor as you pull.
exercises.avoid: Bending your elbows to finish the rep.

exercises.name: Band dead bug with pullover
steps: Anchor the band low behind your head and lie on your back, head toward the anchor.
Hold the band with straight arms above your chest, knees bent at 90 degrees over your hips.
Keep the band still above your chest and slowly straighten one leg toward the floor.
Bring the leg back and switch.
exercises.cue: The band pulling your arms back makes your abs work to keep the ribs down.
exercises.avoid: Lower back arching off the floor.

exercises.name: Kneeling band pull-down
steps: Anchor the band high, over a pull-up bar or the top of a door.
Kneel facing it, holding an end in each hand with arms reaching up.
Pull your elbows down to your ribs, chest proud.
Return slowly.
exercises.cue: Pull your shoulder blades down first, then bend your elbows.
exercises.avoid: Leaning way back to cheat the rep.

exercises.name: Band overhead press
steps: Stand on the middle of the band, feet hip-width.
Hold an end in each hand at your shoulders.
Press straight overhead until your arms are locked out.
Lower slowly to your shoulders.
exercises.cue: Squeeze your glutes so your lower back doesn't arch.
exercises.avoid: Leaning back as the band gets tight.

exercises.name: Band woodchop
steps: Anchor the band high and stand side-on to it, holding the end with both hands above your near shoulder.
Step away until there's tension.
Pull the band diagonally across your body down to the opposite hip, turning your chest and pivoting your back foot.
Return slowly. Finish all reps, then face the other way.
exercises.cue: Rotate through your upper back and hips together.
exercises.avoid: Bending your arms: they stay long and the trunk does the work.

exercises.name: Band squat + press
steps: Stand on the band, feet shoulder-width, ends in your hands at your shoulders.
Squat down.
Stand up hard and press the band overhead in one motion.
Lower your hands to your shoulders and go into the next squat.
exercises.cue: Use the drive from your legs to start the press.
exercises.avoid: Knees caving in as the band pulls on the way up.

exercises.name: Banded glute bridge
steps: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat. Lay the band across your hips and pin each end to the floor with your hands.
Drive through your heels and lift your hips against the band.
Squeeze your glutes at the top for a second.
Lower slowly.
exercises.cue: Push your knees slightly out as you lift.
exercises.avoid: Arching your lower back instead of squeezing your glutes.

exercises.name: Plate ground to overhead
steps: Stand with the plate flat on the floor between your feet.
Hinge and bend your knees to grab the plate by its rim, hands at 3 and 9 o'clock.
Drive through your legs and extend your hips to bring the plate up to your chest.
Keep the momentum going and press it straight overhead, arms locked. Lower it back to the floor under control.
exercises.cue: The hips do the lifting; the arms just finish it overhead.
exercises.avoid: Rounding your back to pick the plate up.

exercises.name: Plate halo
steps: Stand tall holding the plate by its rim at chest height.
Circle it around your head, close to your skull: past one ear, behind your head, past the other ear.
Bring it back to your chest. That's one rep.
Finish all reps, then circle the other way.
exercises.cue: Squeeze your glutes and abs so only your arms move.
exercises.avoid: Leaning or arching as the plate goes behind your head.

exercises.name: Plate overhead squat
steps: Press the plate overhead and lock your arms, holding it by its rim.
Squat as deep as you can with your chest up and the plate over your mid-foot.
Stand back up without letting the plate drift forward.
Keep your arms locked for every rep.
exercises.cue: Push the plate to the ceiling throughout the squat.
exercises.avoid: The plate drifting in front of your face.

exercises.name: Plate overhead walking lunge
steps: Press the plate overhead and lock your arms.
Step forward into a lunge until your back knee is just off the floor.
Drive up and step straight into the next lunge on the other leg.
Keep the plate stacked over your shoulders the whole way.
exercises.cue: Ribs down, arms up, eyes forward.
exercises.avoid: Arching your lower back to hold the plate up.

exercises.name: Plate squeeze press
steps: Hold the plate flat between your palms at your chest, squeezing it hard.
Press it straight out in front of you until your arms are straight.
Keep squeezing and bring it back to your chest.
Stand tall throughout.
exercises.cue: Squeeze as if you're trying to crush the plate; that's what works your chest.
exercises.avoid: Letting the squeeze go on the way back.

exercises.name: Plate bent-over row
steps: Hold the plate by its rim, hinge at your hips until your chest faces the floor, back flat.
Let the plate hang at arm's length.
Row it to your lower chest, elbows back.
Lower slowly.
exercises.cue: Lead with your elbows and squeeze your shoulder blades together.
exercises.avoid: Standing up as you row.

exercises.name: Plate Russian twist
steps: Sit with knees bent, holding the plate at your chest, and lean back until your abs switch on.
Lift your feet off the floor to make it harder.
Rotate your chest and plate to one side, then the other.
Keep your back long throughout.
exercises.cue: Turn your chest, not just your arms.
exercises.avoid: Rounding your back into a slump.

exercises.name: Plate woodchop
steps: Hold the plate by its rim above one shoulder, arms long.
Chop it diagonally across your body down to the outside of the opposite knee, squatting slightly and pivoting your back foot.
Drive it back up the same diagonal.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.
exercises.cue: Power comes from the hips turning, not the arms.
exercises.avoid: Rounding your back at the bottom of the chop.

exercises.name: Plate push
steps: Put a plate flat on a smooth floor or turf, on a towel if the floor is delicate.
Put both hands on top of it, arms straight, hips at shoulder height.
Drive the plate forward with short, fast, powerful steps.
Push to the end of your space, turn around and push back.
exercises.cue: Stay low with a flat back; think sprint, not walk.
exercises.avoid: Letting your hips rise so the push becomes all arms.

exercises.name: Plate pinch carry
steps: Pinch a plate by its smooth rim in each hand, fingers on one side and thumb on the other.
Stand tall with your shoulders back.
Walk with short, controlled steps.
Set the plates down before they slip.
exercises.cue: Pinch hard with your thumb.
exercises.avoid: Hooking your fingers into the plate's hole: that makes it much easier.

exercises.name: Ground to overhead + halo + squat
steps: Pick the plate up off the floor by its rim and drive it overhead in one motion.
Bring it down to your chest and do one halo each direction.
Holding the plate at your chest, squat as deep as you can.
Stand up and lower the plate to the floor. That's one rep.
exercises.cue: Brace hard at every change of position.
exercises.avoid: Letting your back round on the way down to the floor.

exercises.name: Halo reverse lunge
steps: Hold the plate at your chest and step back into a reverse lunge.
At the bottom, keeping your back knee just off the floor, do one full halo around your head.
Drive up through your front foot to stand.
Alternate legs, circling the other way each time.
exercises.cue: Hold the lunge dead still while the plate travels.
exercises.avoid: Back knee resting on the floor during the halo.

exercises.name: Overhead lunge + twist
steps: Press the plate overhead and step forward into a lunge.
At the bottom, lower the plate to your chest and rotate toward your front leg.
Turn back to the middle and press the plate overhead again.
Stand up and lunge with the other leg.
exercises.cue: The front knee stays still while your chest turns.
exercises.avoid: Front knee caving in as you rotate.

exercises.name: Plate sit-up + press + twist
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent, the plate on your chest.
Sit up and, at the top, press the plate straight overhead.
Bring it back to your chest and twist once to each side.
Lower yourself back down slowly. That's one rep.
exercises.cue: Take three seconds to lower each time.
exercises.avoid: Yanking the sit-up with your neck.

exercises.name: Push-up + plate drag-through
steps: Set up a push-up with a plate flat on the floor just outside one hand.
Do a push-up.
Reach under your body with the far hand, grab the plate and drag it across to the other side.
Do a push-up and drag it back. Alternate sides.
exercises.cue: Feet wide and hips still while one hand drags.
exercises.avoid: Hips swinging or rising as you reach under.

exercises.name: Plate bear-crawl drag
steps: Get into a bear position: hands under shoulders, knees an inch off the floor. Put a plate beside one hand.
Reach under your body with the far hand, grab the plate and drag it to the other side.
Crawl forward one step each side, then drag the plate across again.
Keep going to the end of the space and back.
exercises.cue: Knees stay an inch off the floor the whole time.
exercises.avoid: Hips rising into a pike.

exercises.name: Plate burpee + ground to overhead
steps: Stand behind a plate. Squat down, hands on the plate's rim, and jump your feet back into a plank.
Chest to the floor, push up, and jump your feet back in.
Grab the plate and drive it from the floor to overhead in one motion.
Put it back down and go straight into the next burpee.
exercises.cue: Land the jump-in with feet wide and flat so the lift is safe.
exercises.avoid: Rounding your back to lift the plate when you're tired.

exercises.name: Slow plate squat + squat jumps
steps: Hug the plate to your chest.
Do the squats slowly: four seconds down, a two-second pause at the bottom, then stand.
Put the plate down.
Do the jumps straight away: squat jumps, landing softly.
exercises.cue: Go from the last slow squat to the first jump in under five seconds.
exercises.avoid: Rushing the slow squats; the tempo is the point.

exercises.name: Plate Turkish get-up
steps: Lie on your back holding a light plate straight up over one shoulder with both hands, one knee bent.
Roll onto your opposite elbow, then your hand, then lift your hips.
Sweep your straight leg back into a kneel, then stand up, plate locked out over your head the whole time.
Reverse every step to lie back down. Alternate the side of the bent knee each rep.
exercises.cue: Eyes on the plate for the whole rep.
exercises.avoid: Rushing; every position should be one you could pause in.

exercises.name: Plate pinch carry + overhead carry
steps: Pinch a plate by its rim in each hand and walk.
Without putting them down, bring both plates to your shoulders and press them overhead.
Walk with the plates locked overhead.
Lower them under control.
exercises.cue: Your forearms burn in the first half; the second half tests your shoulders.
exercises.avoid: Leaning back to hold the plates overhead.

exercises.name: Plate complex
steps: Every round, without putting the plate down: 5 ground to overheads.
5 halos each direction.
5 overhead squats.
5 overhead reverse lunges on each leg. That's one round.
exercises.cue: Pick a plate you can hold overhead for a whole round; lighter than you think.
exercises.avoid: Letting the overhead positions get sloppy as you tire.

exercises.name: Plate beast complex
steps: Every round, without resting: 5 burpees with hands on the plate.
5 ground to overheads, straight into 5 halos each direction.
5 overhead squats, then 5 overhead lunge + twist on each leg.
20 seconds of plate Russian twists. That's one round.
exercises.cue: Breathe on every rep; holding your breath will end the round early.
exercises.avoid: Heavy plates. This is a conditioning complex, not a strength test.
